import {
  createSession as createSessionRepository,
  findActiveSessionByRefreshTokenHash,
  listActiveUserSessions,
  revokeAllUserSessions,
  revokeSession,
  revokeSessionByRefreshTokenHash,
  rotateSessionRefreshToken,
} from "../../repositories/sessionRepository.js";

import {
  createOpaqueTokenRecord,
  hashToken,
} from "../../security/tokenSecurity.js";

import {
  getRequestIpHash,
  getRequestUserAgent,
} from "../../security/requestSecurity.js";

import { getRefreshTokenExpiration } from "../../security/sessionCookieSecurity.js";

/*
 * =========================================
 * Session Token Purpose
 * =========================================
 */

const SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_PURPOSE = "session-refresh";

/*
 * =========================================
 * Session Errors
 * =========================================
 */

function createSessionError({ message, code, status = 401, publicMessage }) {
  const error = new Error(message);

  error.name = "SessionError";

  error.code = code;

  error.status = status;

  error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

  return error;
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * API Client Detection
 * =========================================
 */

function detectApiClient(userAgent) {
  if (/PostmanRuntime/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Postman API Client";
  }

  if (/Insomnia/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Insomnia API Client";
  }

  if (/HTTPie/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "HTTPie Client";
  }

  if (/curl/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "cURL Client";
  }

  if (/Wget/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Wget Client";
  }

  return "";
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Browser Detection
 * =========================================
 */

function detectBrowser(userAgent) {
  /*
   * Edge must be checked before Chrome
   * because Edge user agents also contain
   * the word "Chrome".
   */

  if (/Edg\//i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Edge";
  }

  /*
   * Opera must also be checked before
   * Chrome because Chromium-based Opera
   * user agents contain "Chrome".
   */

  if (/OPR\//i.test(userAgent) || /Opera\//i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Opera";
  }

  if (/Chrome\//i.test(userAgent) || /CriOS\//i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Chrome";
  }

  if (/Firefox\//i.test(userAgent) || /FxiOS\//i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Firefox";
  }

  if (
    /Safari\//i.test(userAgent) &&
    !/Chrome\//i.test(userAgent) &&
    !/CriOS\//i.test(userAgent) &&
    !/Chromium\//i.test(userAgent)
  ) {
    return "Safari";
  }

  return "Browser";
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Operating-System Detection
 * =========================================
 */

function detectOperatingSystem(userAgent) {
  /*
   * Check iOS before macOS because some
   * Apple user agents contain overlapping
   * platform information.
   */

  if (/iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "iOS";
  }

  if (/Android/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Android";
  }

  if (/Windows Phone/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Windows Phone";
  }

  if (/Windows/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Windows";
  }

  if (/CrOS/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "ChromeOS";
  }

  if (/Macintosh|Mac OS X/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "macOS";
  }

  if (/Linux/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Linux";
  }

  return "Unknown device";
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Device-Name Detection
 * =========================================
 */

export function detectDeviceName(userAgent) {
  const value = typeof userAgent === "string" ? userAgent.trim() : "";

  if (!value) {
    return "Unknown device";
  }

  /*
   * API clients do not normally provide a
   * browser-style operating-system section.
   * Detect them before browser detection.
   */

  const apiClient = detectApiClient(value);

  if (apiClient) {
    return apiClient.slice(0, 200);
  }

  const browser = detectBrowser(value);

  const operatingSystem = detectOperatingSystem(value);

  return `${browser} on ${operatingSystem}`.slice(0, 200);
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Public Session Mapping
 * =========================================
 */

export function createPublicSession(session, currentSessionId = null) {
  if (!session) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    id: session.id,

    deviceName: session.deviceName || "Unknown device",

    createdAt: session.createdAt,

    lastUsedAt: session.lastUsedAt,

    expiresAt: session.expiresAt,

    isCurrent: Boolean(currentSessionId && session.id === currentSessionId),
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Create Authenticated Session
 * =========================================
 */

export async function createAuthenticatedSession({ userId, request }) {
  const refreshToken = createOpaqueTokenRecord(SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_PURPOSE);

  const userAgent = getRequestUserAgent(request);

  const ipAddressHash = getRequestIpHash(request);

  const expiresAt = getRefreshTokenExpiration();

  const session = await createSessionRepository({
    userId,

    refreshTokenHash: refreshToken.hash,

    deviceName: detectDeviceName(userAgent),

    userAgent,

    ipAddressHash,

    expiresAt,
  });

  return {
    refreshToken: refreshToken.token,

    refreshTokenExpiresAt: session.expiresAt,

    session: createPublicSession(session, session.id),
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Refresh Authenticated Session
 * =========================================
 *
 * Every successful refresh rotates the
 * token. The previous token immediately
 * stops working.
 */

export async function refreshAuthenticatedSession({ refreshToken, request }) {
  if (typeof refreshToken !== "string" || refreshToken.length < 32) {
    throw createSessionError({
      message: "The refresh token is missing or malformed.",

      code: "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID",

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });
  }

  const currentTokenHash = hashToken(
    refreshToken,
    SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_PURPOSE,
  );

  const existing = await findActiveSessionByRefreshTokenHash(currentTokenHash);

  if (!existing) {
    throw createSessionError({
      message: "No active session matches the refresh token.",

      code: "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });
  }

  const nextRefreshToken = createOpaqueTokenRecord(
    SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_PURPOSE,
  );

  const userAgent = getRequestUserAgent(request);

  const expiresAt = getRefreshTokenExpiration();

  const rotatedSession = await rotateSessionRefreshToken({
    sessionId: existing.session.id,

    currentRefreshTokenHash: currentTokenHash,

    newRefreshTokenHash: nextRefreshToken.hash,

    newExpiresAt: expiresAt,

    ipAddressHash: getRequestIpHash(request),

    userAgent,
  });

  if (!rotatedSession) {
    throw createSessionError({
      message: "The session refresh token was already rotated or revoked.",

      code: "SESSION_REFRESH_CONFLICT",

      status: 409,

      publicMessage: "Your session changed in another request. Sign in again.",
    });
  }

  return {
    refreshToken: nextRefreshToken.token,

    refreshTokenExpiresAt: rotatedSession.expiresAt,

    session: createPublicSession(rotatedSession, rotatedSession.id),

    user: existing.user,

    roles: existing.roles,
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Get Authenticated Session
 * =========================================
 *
 * Resolves the current user and session from
 * the refresh-token cookie without rotating
 * the refresh token.
 */

export async function getAuthenticatedSession({ refreshToken }) {
  if (typeof refreshToken !== "string" || refreshToken.length < 32) {
    throw createSessionError({
      message: "The refresh token is missing or malformed.",

      code: "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID",

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });
  }

  const refreshTokenHash = hashToken(
    refreshToken,
    SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_PURPOSE,
  );

  const existing = await findActiveSessionByRefreshTokenHash(refreshTokenHash);

  if (!existing) {
    throw createSessionError({
      message: "No active session matches the refresh token.",

      code: "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });
  }

  return {
    user: existing.user,

    roles: existing.roles,

    session: createPublicSession(existing.session, existing.session.id),
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * List User Sessions
 * =========================================
 */

export async function getUserSessions({ userId, currentSessionId = null }) {
  const sessions = await listActiveUserSessions(userId);

  return sessions.map((session) =>
    createPublicSession(session, currentSessionId),
  );
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Revoke One User Session
 * =========================================
 */

export async function revokeUserSession({ sessionId, userId }) {
  const revokedSession = await revokeSession({
    sessionId,

    userId,

    reason: "user_revoked",
  });

  if (!revokedSession) {
    throw createSessionError({
      message: "The requested session does not exist or is already revoked.",

      code: "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",

      status: 404,

      publicMessage: "The requested session was not found.",
    });
  }

  return {
    sessionId: revokedSession.id,

    revokedAt: revokedSession.revokedAt,
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Revoke Current Session
 * =========================================
 */

export async function revokeCurrentSession({
  refreshToken,
  reason = "logout",
}) {
  if (typeof refreshToken !== "string" || !refreshToken) {
    return {
      revoked: false,
    };
  }

  const refreshTokenHash = hashToken(
    refreshToken,
    SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_PURPOSE,
  );

  const revokedSession = await revokeSessionByRefreshTokenHash({
    refreshTokenHash,

    reason,
  });

  return {
    revoked: Boolean(revokedSession),

    sessionId: revokedSession?.id || null,
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Revoke All User Sessions
 * =========================================
 */

export async function revokeEveryUserSession({
  userId,
  exceptSessionId = null,
  reason = "all_sessions_revoked",
}) {
  const normalizedReason =
    String(reason).trim().slice(0, 200) || "all_sessions_revoked";

  const revokedCount = await revokeAllUserSessions({
    userId,

    exceptSessionId,

    reason: normalizedReason,
  });

  return {
    revokedCount,
  };
}

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

import { getEnvironment } from "../../config/environment.js";

const environment = getEnvironment();

/*
 * =========================================
 * User Storage Identity
 * =========================================
 */

export function getProfilePictureUserDirectory(userId) {
  const normalizedUserId = String(userId || "").trim();

  if (!normalizedUserId) {
    throw new Error(
      "An authenticated user ID is required for profile-picture storage.",
    );
  }

  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(normalizedUserId).digest("hex");
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Storage Root
 * =========================================
 */

export function getProfilePictureStorageRoot() {
  const storageRoot = String(
    environment.PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH || "",
  ).trim();

  if (!storageRoot) {
    throw new Error("PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH is not configured.");
  }

  return path.resolve(storageRoot);
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * User Storage Path
 * =========================================
 */

export function getProfilePictureUserStoragePath(userId) {
  return path.join(
    getProfilePictureStorageRoot(),
    getProfilePictureUserDirectory(userId),
  );
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Storage Key
 * =========================================
 */

export function createProfilePictureStorageKey(userId, fileName) {
  const safeFileName = path.basename(String(fileName || "").trim());

  if (!safeFileName) {
    throw new Error("A profile-picture filename is required.");
  }

  return [getProfilePictureUserDirectory(userId), safeFileName].join("/");
}

export function resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(userId, storageKey) {
  const normalizedStorageKey = String(storageKey || "")
    .trim()
    .replaceAll("\\", "/");

  if (!normalizedStorageKey) {
    throw new Error("A profile-picture storage key is required.");
  }

  const userDirectory = getProfilePictureUserDirectory(userId);

  const expectedPrefix = `${userDirectory}/`;

  if (!normalizedStorageKey.startsWith(expectedPrefix)) {
    throw new Error(
      "The profile-picture storage key does not belong to the authenticated user.",
    );
  }

  const relativeFileName = normalizedStorageKey.slice(expectedPrefix.length);

  /*
   * A profile picture must be one file directly inside
   * the authenticated user's storage directory.
   */

  if (
    !relativeFileName ||
    relativeFileName.includes("/") ||
    relativeFileName === "." ||
    relativeFileName === ".." ||
    path.basename(relativeFileName) !== relativeFileName
  ) {
    throw new Error("The profile-picture storage key is invalid.");
  }

  const userStoragePath = path.resolve(
    getProfilePictureUserStoragePath(userId),
  );

  const resolvedFilePath = path.resolve(userStoragePath, relativeFileName);

  /*
   * Defense in depth:
   * even after validating the storage key above, verify that
   * the resulting file remains directly inside this user's
   * storage directory.
   */

  if (path.dirname(resolvedFilePath) !== userStoragePath) {
    throw new Error(
      "The profile-picture path is outside the authenticated user's storage directory.",
    );
  }

  return resolvedFilePath;
}

export async function deleteOwnedProfilePicture(userId, storageKey) {
  const filePath = resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(userId, storageKey);

  try {
    await fs.unlink(filePath);

    return {
      deleted: true,
      storageKey,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    /*
     * If the file is already gone, cleanup has still reached
     * the desired state. Treat deletion as idempotent.
     */

    if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
      return {
        deleted: false,
        storageKey,
      };
    }

    throw error;
  }
}

import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

import { getEnvironment } from "../../config/environment.js";

function requireIdentifier(value, label) {
  const normalized = String(value ?? "").trim();

  if (!normalized) {
    throw new Error(`${label} is required for Project document storage.`);
  }

  return normalized;
}

function hashIdentifier(value) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
}

function validateFileName(fileName) {
  const normalized = String(fileName ?? "").trim();

  if (
    !normalized ||
    normalized === "." ||
    normalized === ".." ||
    normalized.includes("/") ||
    normalized.includes("\\") ||
    path.basename(normalized) !== normalized ||
    !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}\.(?:pdf|doc|docx|ppt|pptx|xls|xlsx|txt|md|csv|json|zip|jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$/i.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Project document filename.");
  }

  return normalized;
}

export function getProjectDocumentStorageRoot() {
  const environment = getEnvironment();

  const configuredPath = String(
    environment.PROJECT_DOCUMENT_STORAGE_PATH || "",
  ).trim();

  if (!configuredPath) {
    throw new Error("PROJECT_DOCUMENT_STORAGE_PATH is not configured.");
  }

  return path.resolve(configuredPath);
}

export function getProjectDocumentUserDirectory(userId) {
  return hashIdentifier(requireIdentifier(userId, "User ID"));
}

export function getProjectDocumentProjectDirectory(projectId) {
  return hashIdentifier(requireIdentifier(projectId, "Project ID"));
}

export function getProjectDocumentDirectory(userId, projectId) {
  return path.join(
    getProjectDocumentStorageRoot(),
    getProjectDocumentUserDirectory(userId),
    getProjectDocumentProjectDirectory(projectId),
  );
}

export function createProjectDocumentStorageKey(userId, projectId, fileName) {
  const safeFileName = validateFileName(fileName);

  return [
    getProjectDocumentUserDirectory(userId),
    getProjectDocumentProjectDirectory(projectId),
    safeFileName,
  ].join("/");
}

export function resolveOwnedProjectDocumentPath(userId, projectId, storageKey) {
  const normalizedKey = String(storageKey ?? "").trim();

  const expectedUserDirectory = getProjectDocumentUserDirectory(userId);
  const expectedProjectDirectory = getProjectDocumentProjectDirectory(projectId);

  const parts = normalizedKey.split("/");

  if (
    parts.length !== 3 ||
    parts[0] !== expectedUserDirectory ||
    parts[1] !== expectedProjectDirectory
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Project document storage key does not belong to this user and Project.",
    );
  }

  const safeFileName = validateFileName(parts[2]);

  const mediaDirectory = path.resolve(
    getProjectDocumentDirectory(userId, projectId),
  );

  const filePath = path.resolve(mediaDirectory, safeFileName);

  if (path.dirname(filePath) !== mediaDirectory) {
    throw new Error("Project document path is outside the expected directory.");
  }

  return filePath;
}

export async function assertSafeProjectDocumentDirectory(userId, projectId) {
  const root = getProjectDocumentStorageRoot();
  const userDirectory = path.join(root, getProjectDocumentUserDirectory(userId));
  const projectDirectory = path.join(
    userDirectory,
    getProjectDocumentProjectDirectory(projectId),
  );

  const directories = [root, userDirectory, projectDirectory];

  for (const directory of directories) {
    const stats = await fs.lstat(directory);

    if (stats.isSymbolicLink() || !stats.isDirectory()) {
      throw new Error(
        "Project document storage directory is not a regular directory.",
      );
    }
  }

  const canonicalRoot = await fs.realpath(root);
  const canonicalProjectDirectory = await fs.realpath(projectDirectory);

  const relative = path.relative(
    canonicalRoot,
    canonicalProjectDirectory,
  );

  if (
    relative === "" ||
    relative === ".." ||
    relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) ||
    path.isAbsolute(relative)
  ) {
    throw new Error("Project document directory is outside the storage root.");
  }
}

export async function deleteOwnedProjectDocument(userId, projectId, storageKey) {
  const filePath = resolveOwnedProjectDocumentPath(userId, projectId, storageKey);

  try {
    await assertSafeProjectDocumentDirectory(userId, projectId);

    const stats = await fs.lstat(filePath);

    if (stats.isSymbolicLink() || !stats.isFile()) {
      throw new Error("Project document target is not a regular file.");
    }

    await fs.unlink(filePath);

      storageKey,
    };
  } catch (error) {

      return {

FILE: D:\Documents\Project\Portfolio\portfolio-plateform\backend\src\services\Storage\projectMediaStorageService.js
--------------------------------------------------
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

import { getEnvironment } from "../../config/environment.js";

function requireIdentifier(value, label) {
  const normalized = String(value ?? "").trim();

  if (!normalized) {
    throw new Error(`${label} is required for Project media storage.`);
  }

  return normalized;
}

function hashIdentifier(value) {
  return crypto.createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
}

function validateFileName(fileName) {
  const normalized = String(fileName ?? "").trim();

  if (
    !normalized ||
    normalized === "." ||
    normalized === ".." ||
    normalized.includes("/") ||
    normalized.includes("\\") ||
    path.basename(normalized) !== normalized ||
    !/^[a-f0-9-]{36}\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp|avif|gif|mp4|webm)$/i.test(
      normalized,
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error("Invalid Project media filename.");
  }

  return normalized;
}

export function getProjectMediaStorageRoot() {
  const environment = getEnvironment();

  const configuredPath = String(
    environment.PROJECT_MEDIA_STORAGE_PATH || "",
  ).trim();

  if (!configuredPath) {
    throw new Error("PROJECT_MEDIA_STORAGE_PATH is not configured.");
  }

  return path.resolve(configuredPath);
}

export function getProjectMediaUserDirectory(userId) {
  return hashIdentifier(requireIdentifier(userId, "User ID"));
}

export function getProjectMediaProjectDirectory(projectId) {
  return hashIdentifier(requireIdentifier(projectId, "Project ID"));
}

export function getProjectMediaDirectory(userId, projectId) {
  return path.join(
    getProjectMediaStorageRoot(),
    getProjectMediaUserDirectory(userId),
    getProjectMediaProjectDirectory(projectId),
  );
}

export function createProjectMediaStorageKey(userId, projectId, fileName) {
  const safeFileName = validateFileName(fileName);

  return [
    getProjectMediaUserDirectory(userId),
    getProjectMediaProjectDirectory(projectId),
    safeFileName,
  ].join("/");
}

export function resolveOwnedProjectMediaPath(userId, projectId, storageKey) {
  const normalizedKey = String(storageKey ?? "").trim();

  const expectedUserDirectory = getProjectMediaUserDirectory(userId);
  const expectedProjectDirectory = getProjectMediaProjectDirectory(projectId);

  const parts = normalizedKey.split("/");

  if (
    parts.length !== 3 ||
    parts[0] !== expectedUserDirectory ||
    parts[1] !== expectedProjectDirectory
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "Project media storage key does not belong to this user and Project.",
    );
  }

  const safeFileName = validateFileName(parts[2]);

  const mediaDirectory = path.resolve(
    getProjectMediaDirectory(userId, projectId),
  );

  const filePath = path.resolve(mediaDirectory, safeFileName);

  if (path.dirname(filePath) !== mediaDirectory) {
    throw new Error("Project media path is outside the expected directory.");
  }

  return filePath;
}

export async function assertSafeProjectMediaDirectory(userId, projectId) {
  const root = getProjectMediaStorageRoot();
  const userDirectory = path.join(root, getProjectMediaUserDirectory(userId));
  const projectDirectory = path.join(
    userDirectory,
    getProjectMediaProjectDirectory(projectId),
  );

  const directories = [root, userDirectory, projectDirectory];

  for (const directory of directories) {
    const stats = await fs.lstat(directory);

    if (stats.isSymbolicLink() || !stats.isDirectory()) {
      throw new Error(
        "Project media storage directory is not a regular directory.",
      );
    }
  }

  const canonicalRoot = await fs.realpath(root);
  const canonicalProjectDirectory = await fs.realpath(projectDirectory);

  const relative = path.relative(
    canonicalRoot,
    canonicalProjectDirectory,
  );

  if (
    relative === "" ||
    relative === ".." ||
    relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) ||
    path.isAbsolute(relative)
  ) {
    throw new Error("Project media directory is outside the storage root.");
  }
}

export async function deleteOwnedProjectMedia(userId, projectId, storageKey) {
  const filePath = resolveOwnedProjectMediaPath(userId, projectId, storageKey);

  try {
    await assertSafeProjectMediaDirectory(userId, projectId);

    const stats = await fs.lstat(filePath);

    if (stats.isSymbolicLink() || !stats.isFile()) {
      throw new Error("Project media target is not a regular file.");
    }

    await fs.unlink(filePath);

    return {
      deleted: true,
      storageKey,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.code === "ENOENT") {
      return {
        deleted: false,
        storageKey,
      };
    }

    throw error;
  }
}

/*

function createPublicError({
  message,
  code,
  status,
  publicMessage,
  fieldErrors,
  errors,
}) {
  const error = new Error(message);

  error.name = "TestPublicError";

  error.code = code;

  error.status = status;

  error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

  error.fieldErrors = fieldErrors || {};

  error.errors = errors || [];

  return error;
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Cookie Helpers
 * =========================================
 */

function getSetCookieHeaders(response) {
  const setCookie = response.headers["set-cookie"];

  return Array.isArray(setCookie) ? setCookie : [];
}

function getCookiePair(response) {
  const [cookieHeader] = getSetCookieHeaders(response);

  if (!cookieHeader) {
    return "";
  }

  return cookieHeader.split(";")[0].trim();
}

    assert.equal(response.body.debug, undefined);

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length, 0);
  });

  it("revokes a created session when its refresh cookie cannot be written", async () => {
    /*
     * sessionCookieSecurity rejects tokens
     * shorter than 32 characters.
     */

    serviceState.refreshToken = "too-short";

    const response = await api
      .post("/api/auth/login/verify")
      .send({
        challengeId: TEST_CHALLENGE_ID,

        otp: "123456",
      })
      .expect(500);

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "error");

    assert.deepEqual(serviceState.revocationInput, {
      refreshToken: "too-short",

      reason: "cookie_write_failed",
    });

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length, 0);
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Logout
   * =========================================
   */

  it("revokes the current session and clears its refresh-token cookie", async () => {
    /*
     * First perform successful OTP
     * verification so we can use the exact
     * configured cookie name.
     */

    const loginResponse = await api
      .post("/api/auth/login/verify")
      .send({
        challengeId: TEST_CHALLENGE_ID,

        otp: "123456",
      })
      .expect(200);

    const cookiePair = getCookiePair(loginResponse);

    assert.ok(cookiePair);

    /*
     * Reset only the recorded revocation;
     * keep the generated cookie available
     * for the logout request.
     */

    serviceState.revocationInput = null;

    const logoutResponse = await api
      .post("/api/auth/logout")
      .set("Cookie", cookiePair)
      .send({})
      .expect(200)
      .expect("Content-Type", /json/);

    assert.equal(logoutResponse.body.status, "success");

    assert.equal(
      logoutResponse.body.message,
      "You have been signed out successfully.",
    );

    assert.deepEqual(serviceState.revocationInput, {
      refreshToken: TEST_REFRESH_TOKEN,

      reason: "logout",
    });

    const clearCookieHeaders = getSetCookieHeaders(logoutResponse);

    assert.equal(clearCookieHeaders.length > 0, true);

    assert.match(clearCookieHeaders[0], /Expires=/i);

    assert.match(clearCookieHeaders[0], /HttpOnly/i);

    assert.match(logoutResponse.headers["cache-control"], /no-store/);
  });

  it("allows an idempotent logout when no refresh-token cookie exists", async () => {
    const response = await api.post("/api/auth/logout").send({}).expect(200);

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "success");

    assert.deepEqual(serviceState.revocationInput, {
      refreshToken: "",

      reason: "logout",
    });

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length > 0, true);
  });

  it("does not clear the cookie when session revocation fails", async () => {
    serviceState.revocationError = createPublicError({
      message: "Database session revocation failed.",

      code: "SESSION_REVOCATION_FAILED",

      status: 503,

      publicMessage:
        "You could not be signed out completely. Please try again.",
    });

    const response = await api
      .post("/api/auth/logout")
      .set("Cookie", `temporary_refresh_cookie=${TEST_REFRESH_TOKEN}`)
      .send({})
      .expect(503);

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "error");

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "SESSION_REVOCATION_FAILED");

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length, 0);
  });
});

      fs.rmdirSync(userDirectory);

import "dotenv/config";

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { after, before, describe, it } from "node:test";
import supertest from "supertest";

process.env.NODE_ENV = "test";

const TEST_USER_DIRECTORY = "static-serving-test-user";
const TEST_FILE_NAME = "profile-picture.jpg";

const PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH = process.env.PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH;

let testDirectory;
let testFilePath;

const { default: app } = await import("../../src/app.js");

const api = supertest(app);

describe("profile picture static serving", () => {
  before(() => {
    assert.ok(
      PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH,
      "PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH must be configured for this test.",
    );

    testDirectory = path.join(
      PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH,
      TEST_USER_DIRECTORY,
    );

    testFilePath = path.join(testDirectory, TEST_FILE_NAME);

    fs.mkdirSync(testDirectory, {
      recursive: true,
    });

    fs.writeFileSync(testFilePath, Buffer.from([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xd9]));
  });

  after(() => {
    if (testFilePath && fs.existsSync(testFilePath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(testFilePath);
    }

    if (
      testDirectory &&
      fs.existsSync(testDirectory) &&
      fs.readdirSync(testDirectory).length === 0
    ) {
      fs.rmdirSync(testDirectory);
    }
  });

  it("serves a stored profile picture as a public image", async () => {
    const response = await api
      .get(`/uploads/profile-pictures/${TEST_USER_DIRECTORY}/${TEST_FILE_NAME}`)
      .expect(200);

    assert.equal(response.headers["content-type"], "image/jpeg");

    assert.equal(
      response.headers["cross-origin-resource-policy"],
      "cross-origin",
    );

    assert.equal(Number(response.headers["content-length"]), 4);
  });

  it("does not expose a directory index", async () => {
    await api
      .get(`/uploads/profile-pictures/${TEST_USER_DIRECTORY}/`)
      .expect(404);
  });

  it("returns 404 for a profile picture that does not exist", async () => {
    await api
      .get(`/uploads/profile-pictures/${TEST_USER_DIRECTORY}/missing.jpg`)
      .expect(404);
  });
});

      const { createProjectDocumentStorageKey } =

        originalFileName: uploadedFile.originalname,

        fileSize: uploadedFile.verifiedSize,
      };

      return state.document;

    async listAuthenticatedProjectDocuments({ userId, projectId }) {
      state.listCalls.push({ userId, projectId });
      return state.document ? [state.document] : [];
    },

    async getAuthenticatedProjectDocument({
      userId,
      projectId,
      documentId,
    }) {
      state.getCalls.push({ userId, projectId, documentId });

      if (!state.document || documentId !== DOCUMENT_ID) {
        const error = new Error("Project document not found.");
        error.code = "PROJECT_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND";
        error.status = 404;
        error.publicMessage = error.message;
        throw error;
      }

      return state.document;
    },

    async deleteAuthenticatedProjectDocument({
      userId,
      projectId,
      documentId,
    }) {
      state.deleteCalls.push({ userId, projectId, documentId });

      if (!state.document || documentId !== DOCUMENT_ID) {
        const error = new Error("Project document not found.");
        error.code = "PROJECT_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND";
        error.status = 404;
        error.publicMessage = error.message;
        throw error;
      }

      const deleted = state.document;
      state.document = null;
      return deleted;

  },

describe("Project document API", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetState();

    // Tests only remove files in their own temporary directory.
    fs.rmSync(TEST_ROOT, { recursive: true, force: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(TEST_ROOT, { recursive: true });
  });

  it("requires authentication before uploading", async () => {
    await api
      .post(documentUrl())
      .attach("document", PDF, {
        filename: "test.pdf",
        contentType: "application/pdf",
      })
      .expect(401);

    assert.equal(state.ownershipCalls.length, 0);
    assert.equal(state.registeredUpload, null);
  });

  it("rejects uploads to another user's Project", async () => {
    const response = await authenticated(
      api.post(`/api/projects/${OTHER_PROJECT_ID}/documents`),
    )
      .attach("document", PDF, {
        filename: "test.pdf",
        contentType: "application/pdf",
      })
      .expect(404);

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND");
    assert.equal(state.registeredUpload, null);
  });

  it("uploads a valid PDF into isolated storage", async () => {
    assert.equal(
      getProjectDocumentStorageRoot(),
      path.resolve(TEST_ROOT),
    );

    const response = await authenticated(
      api.post(documentUrl()),
    )
      .attach("document", PDF, {
        filename: "test.pdf",
        contentType: "application/pdf",
      })
      .expect(201);

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "success");
    assert.equal(response.body.data.document.mimeType, "application/pdf");

    assert.equal(state.registeredUpload.userId, USER_ID);
    assert.equal(state.registeredUpload.projectId, PROJECT_ID);

    const uploaded = state.registeredUpload.uploadedFile;

    assert.equal(uploaded.verifiedMimeType, "application/pdf");
    assert.equal(uploaded.verifiedSize, PDF.length);
    assert.equal(fs.readFileSync(uploaded.path).equals(PDF), true);

    const relative = path.relative(TEST_ROOT, uploaded.path);

    assert.ok(relative && !relative.startsWith(".."));
    assert.equal(path.isAbsolute(relative), false);
  });

  it("rejects invalid PDF contents", async () => {
    const response = await authenticated(
      api.post(documentUrl()),
    )
      .attach("document", Buffer.from("Not a PDF document"), {
        filename: "fake.pdf",
        contentType: "application/pdf",
      });

    assert.ok(response.status >= 400 && response.status < 500);
    assert.equal(state.registeredUpload, null);
  });

  it("lists documents for the authenticated owner", async () => {
    const response = await authenticated(
      api.get(documentUrl()),
    ).expect(200);

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "success");
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(response.body.data.documents));
    assert.deepEqual(state.listCalls, [
      { userId: USER_ID, projectId: PROJECT_ID },
    ]);
  });

  it("requires authentication before downloading", async () => {
    await api
      .get(`${documentUrl()}/${DOCUMENT_ID}`)
      .expect(401);

    assert.equal(state.getCalls.length, 0);
  });

  it("downloads a stored document with private headers", async () => {
    const directory = getProjectDocumentDirectory(
      USER_ID,
      PROJECT_ID,
    );

    fs.mkdirSync(directory, { recursive: true });

    const fileName = `${DOCUMENT_ID}.pdf`;
    const filePath = path.join(directory, fileName);

    fs.writeFileSync(filePath, PDF);

    const { createProjectDocumentStorageKey } =
      await import(
        "../../src/services/Storage/projectDocumentStorageService.js"
      );

    state.document = {
      id: DOCUMENT_ID,
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      storageKey: createProjectDocumentStorageKey(
        USER_ID,
        PROJECT_ID,
        fileName,
      ),
      originalFileName: "test.pdf",
      mimeType: "application/pdf",
      fileSize: PDF.length,
    };

    const response = await authenticated(
      api.get(`${documentUrl()}/${DOCUMENT_ID}`),
    ).expect(200);

    assert.equal(response.headers["content-type"], "application/pdf");
    assert.match(response.headers["content-disposition"], /attachment/);
    assert.match(response.headers["cache-control"], /no-store/);

    const downloaded = response.body?.length
      ? response.body
      : Buffer.from(response.text ?? "", "binary");

    assert.equal(downloaded.equals(PDF), true);
  });

  it("rejects downloads from an unowned Project", async () => {
    await authenticated(
      api.get(`/api/projects/${OTHER_PROJECT_ID}/documents/${DOCUMENT_ID}`),
    ).expect(404);

    assert.equal(state.getCalls.length, 0);
  });

  it("deletes document metadata for its owner", async () => {
    state.document = {
      id: DOCUMENT_ID,
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      storageKey: "test-storage-key",
      originalFileName: "test.pdf",
      mimeType: "application/pdf",
      fileSize: PDF.length,
    };

    await authenticated(
      api.delete(`${documentUrl()}/${DOCUMENT_ID}`),
    ).expect(204);

    assert.deepEqual(state.deleteCalls, [
      {
        userId: USER_ID,
        projectId: PROJECT_ID,
        documentId: DOCUMENT_ID,
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("requires authentication before deleting", async () => {
    await api
      .delete(`${documentUrl()}/${DOCUMENT_ID}`)
      .expect(401);

    assert.equal(state.deleteCalls.length, 0);
  });
});

    fs.rmSync(filePath, { force: true });

    try {
      fs.symlinkSync(outsideFile, filePath, "file");

      if (["EPERM", "EACCES", "ENOTSUP"].includes(error.code)) {
        t.skip(`Symbolic links unavailable: ${error.code}`);
        return;
      }

      throw error;
    }

    try {
      const response = await authenticated(
        api.get(`/api/projects/${PROJECT_ID}/media/${MEDIA_ID}`),

      assert.equal(response.body.code, "PROJECT_MEDIA_NOT_FOUND");

      assert.equal(state.getMediaCalls.length, 1);

      fs.rmSync(filePath, { force: true });
      fs.rmSync(outsideFile, { force: true });

function createPublicError({
  message,
  code,
  status,
  publicMessage,
  fieldErrors,
  errors,
}) {
  const error = new Error(message);

  error.name = "TestPublicError";

  error.code = code;

  error.status = status;

  error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

  error.fieldErrors = fieldErrors || {};

  error.errors = errors || [];

  return error;

function createCookieHeader(refreshToken = CURRENT_REFRESH_TOKEN) {
  return "portfolio_refresh_token=" + encodeURIComponent(refreshToken);
}

function getSetCookieHeaders(response) {
  const setCookie = response.headers["set-cookie"];

  return Array.isArray(setCookie) ? setCookie : [];
}

 * Session API Tests

  beforeEach(() => {
    resetServiceState();
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Get Current Session
   * =========================================
   */

  it("returns the current authenticated session", async () => {
    const response = await api
      .get("/api/auth/session")
      .set("Cookie", createCookieHeader())
      .expect(200)
      .expect("Content-Type", /json/);

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "success");

    assert.equal(
      response.body.message,
      "Authenticated session retrieved successfully.",
    );

    assert.equal(response.body.data.user.id, TEST_USER_ID);

    assert.equal(response.body.data.user.email, "jeanpierre.joseph5@gmail.com");

    assert.deepEqual(response.body.data.roles, ["user"]);

    assert.equal(response.body.data.session.id, TEST_SESSION_ID);

    assert.equal(response.body.data.session.isCurrent, true);

    assert.deepEqual(serviceState.getSessionInput, {
      refreshToken: CURRENT_REFRESH_TOKEN,
    });

    /*
     * Reading the current session must not
     * rotate or replace the cookie.
     */

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length, 0);

    assert.match(response.headers["cache-control"], /no-store/);

    assert.equal(response.headers.pragma, "no-cache");

    /*
     * Internal token information must not
     * appear in the JSON response.
     */

    const serializedResponse = JSON.stringify(response.body);

    assert.equal(serializedResponse.includes(CURRENT_REFRESH_TOKEN), false);

    assert.equal(serializedResponse.includes(ROTATED_REFRESH_TOKEN), false);

    assert.equal(response.body.data.session.refreshTokenHash, undefined);
  });

  it("clears the cookie when the current session cookie is missing", async () => {
    serviceState.getSessionError = createPublicError({
      message: "The refresh token is missing or malformed.",

      code: "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID",

      status: 401,

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });

    const response = await api
      .get("/api/auth/session")
      .expect(401)
      .expect("Content-Type", /json/);

    assert.deepEqual(serviceState.getSessionInput, {
      refreshToken: "",
    });

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "error");

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID");

    assert.equal(
      response.body.message,
      "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    );

    const cookieHeaders = getSetCookieHeaders(response);

    assert.equal(cookieHeaders.length > 0, true);

    assert.match(cookieHeaders[0], /portfolio_refresh_token=/i);

    assert.match(cookieHeaders[0], /Expires=/i);
  });

  it("clears an expired or revoked current-session cookie", async () => {
    serviceState.getSessionError = createPublicError({
      message: "No active session matches the refresh token.",

      code: "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",

      status: 401,

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });

    const response = await api

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "SESSION_NOT_FOUND");

  });

  it("does not clear the cookie for an unrelated server error", async () => {

      status: 503,

    });

    const response = await api

      .set("Cookie", createCookieHeader())
      .expect(503);

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE");

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length, 0);
  });

  /*

   * Refresh Session
   * =========================================
   */

  it("rotates the refresh token and replaces its HttpOnly cookie", async () => {
    const response = await api
      .post("/api/auth/session/refresh")
      .set("Cookie", createCookieHeader())
      .send({})

      .expect("Content-Type", /json/);

    assert.equal(response.body.status, "success");

    assert.equal(
      response.body.message,
      "Your session was refreshed successfully.",
    );

    assert.deepEqual(response.body.data.roles, ["user"]);

    assert.equal(response.body.data.session.id, TEST_SESSION_ID);

    assert.equal(serviceState.refreshInput.refreshToken, CURRENT_REFRESH_TOKEN);

    assert.ok(serviceState.refreshInput.request);

    /*

    serviceState.refreshError = createPublicError({
      message: "No active session matches the refresh token.",

      code: "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",

      status: 401,

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });

    const response = await api
      .post("/api/auth/session/refresh")
      .set("Cookie", createCookieHeader())
      .send({})
      .expect(401);

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "SESSION_NOT_FOUND");

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length > 0, true);

    assert.match(getSetCookieHeaders(response)[0], /Expires=/i);
  });

  it("clears the cookie when refresh-token rotation conflicts", async () => {
    serviceState.refreshError = createPublicError({
      message: "The refresh token was already rotated.",

      code: "SESSION_REFRESH_CONFLICT",

      status: 409,

      publicMessage: "Your session changed in another request. Sign in again.",
    });

    const response = await api
      .post("/api/auth/session/refresh")
      .set("Cookie", createCookieHeader())
      .send({})
      .expect(409);

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "SESSION_REFRESH_CONFLICT");

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length > 0, true);
  });

  it("revokes the rotated session when its replacement cookie cannot be written", async () => {
    /*
     * setRefreshTokenCookie rejects tokens
     * shorter than 32 characters.
     */

    serviceState.refreshResult = {
      ...serviceState.refreshResult,

      refreshToken: "too-short",
    };

    const response = await api
      .post("/api/auth/session/refresh")
      .set("Cookie", createCookieHeader())
      .send({})
      .expect(500);

    assert.deepEqual(serviceState.revocationInput, {
      refreshToken: "too-short",

      reason: "refresh_cookie_write_failed",
    });

    /*
     * The controller attempts to remove any
     * unusable browser cookie.
     */

    const cookieHeaders = getSetCookieHeaders(response);

    assert.equal(cookieHeaders.length > 0, true);

    assert.match(cookieHeaders[cookieHeaders.length - 1], /Expires=/i);

    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(response.body).includes("too-short"), false);
  });

  it("does not clear the current cookie for an unrelated refresh server error", async () => {
    serviceState.refreshError = createPublicError({
      message: "The database is temporarily unavailable.",

      code: "DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE",

      status: 503,

      publicMessage: "The service is temporarily unavailable.",
    });

    const response = await api
      .post("/api/auth/session/refresh")
      .set("Cookie", createCookieHeader())
      .send({})
      .expect(503);

    assert.equal(response.body.code, "DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE");

    assert.equal(getSetCookieHeaders(response).length, 0);
  });
});

function createPublicError({ message, code, status = 401, publicMessage }) {
  const error = new Error(message);

  error.name = "TestAuthenticationError";

  error.code = code;

  error.status = status;

  error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

  return error;
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Cookie Helpers
 * =========================================
 */

function createCookieHeader(refreshToken = REFRESH_TOKEN) {
  return "portfolio_refresh_token=" + encodeURIComponent(refreshToken);
}

function getSetCookieHeaders(response) {
  const setCookie = response.headers["set-cookie"];

  return Array.isArray(setCookie) ? setCookie : [];
}

import "dotenv/config";

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { beforeEach, describe, it, mock } from "node:test";

 * =========================================
 * Test Environment

 */

process.env.NODE_ENV = "test";

process.env.AUTH_OTP_HMAC_SECRET =

process.env.AUTH_TOKEN_HMAC_SECRET =

  "test-ip-secret-123456789012345678901234567890";

const { requireAuthentication } =
  await import("../../src/middleware/authenticationMiddleware.js");

/*
 * =========================================
 * Request Factory
 * =========================================
 */

function createRequest({
  refreshToken = REFRESH_TOKEN,
  includeCookie = true,
} = {}) {
  return {
    headers: includeCookie
      ? {
          cookie: "portfolio_refresh_token=" + encodeURIComponent(refreshToken),
        }
      : {},

    cookies: undefined,

    auth: undefined,
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Response Factory
 * =========================================
 */

function createResponse() {
  const response = {
    headers: {},

    clearedCookies: [],

    variedHeaders: [],

    set(values) {
      for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
        this.headers[name.toLowerCase()] = value;
      }

      return this;
    },

    setHeader(name, value) {
      this.headers[String(name).toLowerCase()] = value;

      return this;
    },

    vary(fieldName) {
      this.variedHeaders.push(fieldName);

      return this;
    },

    clearCookie(name, options) {
      this.clearedCookies.push({
        name,

        options,
      });

      return this;
    },
  };

  return response;
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Next Factory
 * =========================================
 */

function createNextState() {
  const state = {
    callCount: 0,

    error: undefined,
  };

  function next(error) {
    state.callCount += 1;

    state.error = error;
  }

  return {
    state,

    next,
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Error Factory
 * =========================================
 */

function createServiceError({ message, code, status = 401, publicMessage }) {
  const error = new Error(message);

  error.name = "TestSessionError";

  error.code = code;

  error.status = status;

  error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

  return error;
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Authentication Middleware Tests
 * =========================================
 */

describe("authenticationMiddleware", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetServiceState();
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Successful Authentication
   * =========================================
   */

  it("authenticates a valid refresh-token session", async () => {
    const request = createRequest();

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.callCount, 1);

    assert.equal(state.error, undefined);

    assert.deepEqual(serviceState.input, {
      refreshToken: REFRESH_TOKEN,
    });

    assert.ok(request.auth);

    assert.equal(request.auth.isAuthenticated, true);

    assert.equal(request.auth.userId, USER_ID);

    assert.equal(request.auth.sessionId, SESSION_ID);

    assert.equal(request.auth.user.email, "jean@example.com");

    assert.equal(request.auth.session.id, SESSION_ID);
  });

  it("normalizes and deduplicates authenticated roles", async () => {
    const request = createRequest();

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.error, undefined);

    assert.deepEqual(request.auth.roles, ["user", "admin"]);

    assert.equal(Object.isFrozen(request.auth.roles), true);

    assert.equal(Object.isFrozen(request.auth), true);
  });

  it("does not expose the raw refresh token through request.auth", async () => {
    const request = createRequest();

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.error, undefined);

    const serializedAuth = JSON.stringify(request.auth);

    assert.equal(serializedAuth.includes(REFRESH_TOKEN), false);

    assert.equal(request.auth.refreshToken, undefined);

    assert.equal(request.auth.refreshTokenHash, undefined);
  });

  it("sets private cache headers for an authenticated request", async () => {
    const request = createRequest();

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.error, undefined);

    assert.match(response.headers["cache-control"], /no-store/);

    assert.equal(response.headers.pragma, "no-cache");

    assert.equal(response.headers.expires, "0");

    assert.deepEqual(response.variedHeaders, ["Cookie"]);
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Missing Cookie
   * =========================================
   */

  it("rejects a request with no refresh-token cookie", async () => {
    const request = createRequest({
      includeCookie: false,
    });

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.callCount, 1);

    assert.ok(state.error);

    assert.equal(state.error.name, "AuthenticationError");

    assert.equal(state.error.code, "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED");

    assert.equal(state.error.status, 401);

    assert.equal(
      state.error.publicMessage,
      "You must sign in to access this resource.",
    );

    /*
     * The service should not be queried
     * when no cookie exists.
     */

    assert.equal(serviceState.input, null);

    assert.equal(request.auth, undefined);

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies.length, 0);
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Invalid or Revoked Session
   * =========================================
   */

  it("clears the cookie when the session is revoked or unavailable", async () => {
    serviceState.error = createServiceError({
      message: "No active session matches the refresh token.",

      code: "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",

      status: 401,

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });

    const request = createRequest();

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.error, serviceState.error);

    assert.equal(request.auth, undefined);

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies.length, 1);

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies[0].name, "portfolio_refresh_token");

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies[0].options.httpOnly, true);

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies[0].options.path, "/api");

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies[0].options.sameSite, "lax");
  });

  it("clears the cookie when the refresh token is malformed", async () => {
    serviceState.error = createServiceError({
      message: "The refresh token is malformed.",

      code: "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID",

      status: 401,

      publicMessage: "Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again.",
    });

    const request = createRequest({
      refreshToken: "malformed-token",
    });

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.error.code, "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID");

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies.length, 1);
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Invalid Authentication Context
   * =========================================
   */

  it("rejects a resolved session that is missing its user identifier", async () => {
    serviceState.result = {
      ...serviceState.result,

      user: {
        email: "jean@example.com",

        accountStatus: "active",
      },
    };

    const request = createRequest();

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.error.code, "AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_INVALID");

    assert.equal(state.error.status, 500);

    assert.equal(request.auth, undefined);

    /*
     * A server-side mapping error should
     * not remove a potentially valid
     * browser session.
     */

    assert.equal(response.clearedCookies.length, 0);
  });

  it("rejects a resolved session that is missing its session identifier", async () => {
    serviceState.result = {
      ...serviceState.result,

      session: {
        ...serviceState.result.session,

        id: "",
      },
    };

    const request = createRequest();

    const response = createResponse();

    const { state, next } = createNextState();

    await requireAuthentication(request, response, next);

    assert.equal(state.error.code, "AUTHENTICATION_CONTEXT_INVALID");

    assert.equal(state.error.status, 500);

    assert.equal(request.auth, undefined);
  });

  /*

   * =========================================

  it("preserves the cookie when the database is temporarily unavailable", async () => {

import "dotenv/config";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

import express from "express";
import request from "supertest";

import { getEnvironment } from "../../src/config/environment.js";
import { uploadProfilePicture } from "../../src/middleware/profile/profilePictureUploadMiddleware.js";
import { validateProfilePicture } from "../../src/middleware/profile/profilePictureValidationMiddleware.js";

const environment = getEnvironment();

const TEST_USER_ID = "profile-picture-middleware-test-user";

const TEST_IMAGE_PATH =
  "D:\\Documents\\Perso Folder\\Pictures\\Jean Pierre.jpg";

test("uploads a profile picture into the authenticated user's storage directory", async () => {
  const app = express();

  /*
   * Simulate the authentication middleware.
   * The real application will obtain this value
   * from the authenticated session.
   */
  app.use((request, response, next) => {
    request.auth = {
      userId: TEST_USER_ID,
    };

    next();
  });

  app.post(
    "/upload",
    uploadProfilePicture,
    validateProfilePicture,
    (request, response) => {
      response.status(201).json({
        file: {
          filename: request.profilePictureFile.filename,
          path: request.profilePictureFile.path,
          mimetype: request.profilePictureFile.mimetype,
          size: request.profilePictureFile.size,
          verifiedMimeType: request.profilePictureFile.verifiedMimeType,
          verifiedExtension: request.profilePictureFile.verifiedExtension,
        },
      });
    },
  );

  const response = await request(app)
    .post("/upload")
    .attach("picture", TEST_IMAGE_PATH);

  assert.equal(response.status, 201);

  assert.equal(response.body.file.mimetype, "image/jpeg");

  assert.equal(response.body.file.verifiedMimeType, "image/jpeg");

  assert.equal(response.body.file.verifiedExtension, "jpg");

  assert.equal(response.body.file.size, 43093);

  /*
   * Reproduce the same user-directory calculation
   * performed by the upload middleware.
   */
  const expectedUserDirectory = crypto
    .createHash("sha256")
    .update(TEST_USER_ID)
    .digest("hex");

  const expectedDirectory = path.join(
    environment.PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH,
    expectedUserDirectory,
  );

  const uploadedFilePath = path.join(
    expectedDirectory,
    response.body.file.filename,
  );

  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(uploadedFilePath), true);

  /*
   * Clean up the test upload after successful
   * verification.
   */
  fs.unlinkSync(uploadedFilePath);

  /*
   * Remove the test user's directory if empty.
   */
  if (fs.readdirSync(expectedDirectory).length === 0) {
    fs.rmdirSync(expectedDirectory);
  }

  assert.equal(fs.existsSync(uploadedFilePath), false);
});

test("rejects fake JPEG content and removes the uploaded file", async () => {
  const app = express();

  app.use((request, response, next) => {
    request.auth = {
      userId: TEST_USER_ID,
    };

    next();
  });

  app.post(
    "/upload",
    uploadProfilePicture,
    validateProfilePicture,
    (request, response) => {
      response.status(201).json({
        message: "Upload accepted.",
      });
    },
  );

  /*
   * Multer sees this as image/jpeg because we explicitly
   * declare that MIME type, but the actual bytes are
   * ordinary text and therefore not a real JPEG.
   */
  const fakeImage = Buffer.from("This is not a JPEG image.", "utf8");

  const response = await request(app)
    .post("/upload")
    .attach("picture", fakeImage, {
      filename: "fake-profile.jpg",
      contentType: "image/jpeg",
    });

  assert.equal(response.status, 400);

  /*
   * Verify that validation did not leave the rejected
   * upload behind on the storage server.
   */
  const expectedUserDirectory = crypto
    .createHash("sha256")
    .update(TEST_USER_ID)
    .digest("hex");

  const expectedDirectory = path.join(
    environment.PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH,
    expectedUserDirectory,
  );

  if (fs.existsSync(expectedDirectory)) {
    assert.equal(
      fs.readdirSync(expectedDirectory).length,
      0,
      "Rejected upload should not remain in storage.",
    );

    fs.rmdirSync(expectedDirectory);
  }
});

test("rejects a profile picture larger than 20 MiB", async () => {
  const app = express();

  app.use((request, response, next) => {
    request.auth = {
      userId: TEST_USER_ID,
    };

    next();
  });

  app.post(
    "/upload",
    uploadProfilePicture,
    validateProfilePicture,
    (request, response) => {
      response.status(201).json({
        message: "Upload accepted.",
      });
    },
  );

  /*
   * 20 MiB is allowed.
   * This buffer is one byte larger than that limit.
   */
  const oversizedImage = Buffer.alloc(20 * 1024 * 1024 + 1, 0);

  const response = await request(app)
    .post("/upload")
    .attach("picture", oversizedImage, {
      filename: "oversized.jpg",
      contentType: "image/jpeg",
    });

  assert.equal(response.status, 413);

  /*
   * Multer must not leave the rejected upload
   * behind in the user's storage directory.
   */
  const expectedUserDirectory = crypto
    .createHash("sha256")
    .update(TEST_USER_ID)
    .digest("hex");

  const expectedDirectory = path.join(
    environment.PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH,
    expectedUserDirectory,
  );

  if (fs.existsSync(expectedDirectory)) {
    assert.equal(
      fs.readdirSync(expectedDirectory).length,
      0,
      "Oversized upload should not remain in storage.",
    );

    fs.rmdirSync(expectedDirectory);
  }
});

FILE: D:\Documents\Project\Portfolio\portfolio-plateform\backend\test\project\projectDocumentOfficeValidation.test.js
--------------------------------------------------
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";
import yauzl from "yauzl";

const OFFICE_FILES = new Map([
  ["docx", "word/document.xml"],
  ["pptx", "ppt/presentation.xml"],
  ["xlsx", "xl/workbook.xml"],
]);

function inspectOfficeArchive(filePath, extension) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const required = new Set([
      "[Content_Types].xml",
      "_rels/.rels",
      OFFICE_FILES.get(extension),
    ]);

    yauzl.open(
      filePath,
      {
        lazyEntries: true,
        autoClose: true,
        validateEntrySizes: true,
        strictFileNames: true,
      },
      (error, archive) => {
        if (error) {
          resolve(false);
          return;
        }

        let finished = false;

        const finish = (result) => {
          if (finished) return;
          finished = true;
          archive.close();
          resolve(result);
        };

        archive.on("error", () => finish(false));

        archive.on("entry", (entry) => {
          required.delete(entry.fileName);
          archive.readEntry();
        });

        archive.on("end", () => finish(required.size === 0));

        archive.readEntry();
      },
    );
  });
}

test("ordinary ZIP is rejected as DOCX", async () => {
  const directory = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), "project-doc-test-"),
  );

  try {
    const filePath = path.join(directory, "ordinary.zip");

    // A minimal empty ZIP archive.
    const emptyZip = Buffer.from(
      "504b0506000000000000000000000000000000000000",
      "hex",
    );

    await fs.writeFile(filePath, emptyZip);

    const valid = await inspectOfficeArchive(filePath, "docx");

    assert.equal(valid, false);
  } finally {
    await fs.rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test("invalid ZIP data is rejected", async () => {
  const directory = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), "project-doc-test-"),
  );

  try {
    const filePath = path.join(directory, "invalid.zip");

    await fs.writeFile(filePath, "not a ZIP archive");

    const valid = await inspectOfficeArchive(filePath, "xlsx");

    assert.equal(valid, false);
  } finally {
    await fs.rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

    },
    listAuthenticatedProjectMedia: async () => [REGISTERED_MEDIA],

function createRequest() {
  return {
    auth: { userId: USER_ID },
    params: { projectId: PROJECT_ID },
    projectMediaFile: {
      filename: FILENAME,
      originalname: "portfolio.png",
      verifiedMimeType: "image/png",
      verifiedSize: 2048,
    },
  };
}

function createResponse() {
  return {
    statusCode: 200,
    headers: {},
    body: null,

    set(headers) {
      Object.assign(this.headers, headers);
      return this;
    },

    status(code) {
      this.statusCode = code;
      return this;
    },

    json(body) {
      this.body = body;
      return this;
    },
  };
}

function resetMocks() {
  registrationError = null;
  registrationCalls = [];
}

test("returns HTTP 201 after successful media registration", async () => {
  resetMocks();

  const request = createRequest();
  const response = createResponse();
  const nextCalls = [];

  await uploadMyProjectMedia(request, response, (error) =>
    nextCalls.push(error),
  );

  assert.equal(response.statusCode, 201);
  assert.equal(response.body.status, "success");
  assert.equal(response.body.message, "Project media uploaded successfully.");
  assert.deepEqual(response.body.data.media, REGISTERED_MEDIA);

  assert.equal(
    response.headers["Cache-Control"],
    "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private",
  );

  assert.deepEqual(registrationCalls, [
    {
      userId: USER_ID,
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      uploadedFile: request.projectMediaFile,
    },
  ]);

  assert.equal(nextCalls.length, 0);
});

function createMockDatabase(recordset = [], rowsAffected = [1]) {
  const parameters = [];
  const queries = [];

  const request = {
    input(name, type, value) {
      parameters.push({
        name,
        type,
        value,
      });

      return this;
    },

    async query(queryText) {
      queries.push(queryText);

      return {
        recordset,
        rowsAffected,
      };
    },
  };

  return {
    parameters,
    queries,

    pool: {
      request() {
        return request;
      },
    },
  };
}

function mockDatabase(recordset = [], rowsAffected = [1]) {
  activeDatabase = createMockDatabase(recordset, rowsAffected);

  return activeDatabase;
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Parameter Assertion Helper
 * =========================================
 */

function assertParameter(database, name, expectedValue) {
  const parameter = database.parameters.find(
    (item) => item.name === name,
  );

  assert.ok(
    parameter,
    `Expected SQL parameter "${name}" to exist.`,
  );

  assert.equal(
    parameter.value,
    expectedValue,
    `Unexpected value for SQL parameter "${name}".`,
  );
}

test("rejects symbolic-link media files", async (t) => {
  const linkedFileName = "123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174010.jpg";
  const storageKey = createProjectMediaStorageKey(
    userId,
    projectId,
    linkedFileName,
  );

  const directory = getProjectMediaDirectory(userId, projectId);
  const linkedPath = resolveOwnedProjectMediaPath(
    userId,
    projectId,
    storageKey,
  );

  const externalFile = path.join(temporaryRoot, "external-media.txt");

  await fs.mkdir(directory, { recursive: true });
  await fs.writeFile(externalFile, "external content");

  try {
    await fs.symlink(externalFile, linkedPath, "file");
  } catch (error) {
    if (["EPERM", "EACCES", "ENOTSUP"].includes(error?.code)) {
      t.skip(`Symbolic-link creation unavailable: ${error.code}`);
      return;
    }

    throw error;
  }

  try {
    await assert.rejects(
      deleteOwnedProjectMedia(userId, projectId, storageKey),
      /not a regular file/,
    );

    assert.equal(
      await fs.readFile(externalFile, "utf8"),
      "external content",
    );

    assert.equal((await fs.lstat(linkedPath)).isSymbolicLink(), true);
  } finally {
    await fs.unlink(linkedPath);
  }
});

test("rejects redirected Project directories", async (t) => {
  const redirectedProjectId = "redirected-project";
  const linkedDirectory = getProjectMediaDirectory(

  const externalDirectory = path.join(

  await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(linkedDirectory), { recursive: true });
  await fs.mkdir(externalDirectory, { recursive: true });

  const externalFile = path.join(externalDirectory, linkedFileName);
  await fs.writeFile(externalFile, "protected external content");

  try {
    await fs.symlink(
      externalDirectory,
      linkedDirectory,
      process.platform === "win32" ? "junction" : "dir",
    );
  } catch (error) {
    if (["EPERM", "EACCES", "ENOTSUP"].includes(error?.code)) {
      t.skip(`Directory link creation unavailable: ${error.code}`);
      return;
    }

    throw error;
  }

  try {
    await assert.rejects(
      deleteOwnedProjectMedia(userId, redirectedProjectId, storageKey),
      /not a regular directory/,
    );

    assert.equal(
      await fs.readFile(externalFile, "utf8"),
      "protected external content",
    );
  } finally {
    await fs.unlink(linkedDirectory);
  }
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { after, before, test } from "node:test";

import express from "express";
import supertest from "supertest";

import {
  uploadProjectMedia,
} from "../../src/middleware/project/projectMediaUploadMiddleware.js";

let temporaryDirectory;
let originalStoragePath;

const USER_ID = "user-123";
const PROJECT_ID = "project-456";

const JPEG_BYTES = Buffer.from([
  0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0,
  0x00, 0x10, 0x4a, 0x46,
  0x49, 0x46, 0x00, 0x01,
]);

before(async () => {
  temporaryDirectory = await fs.mkdtemp(
    path.join(os.tmpdir(), "project-media-upload-test-"),
  );

  originalStoragePath = process.env.PROJECT_MEDIA_STORAGE_PATH;
  process.env.PROJECT_MEDIA_STORAGE_PATH = temporaryDirectory;
});

after(async () => {
  if (originalStoragePath === undefined) {
    delete process.env.PROJECT_MEDIA_STORAGE_PATH;
  } else {
    process.env.PROJECT_MEDIA_STORAGE_PATH = originalStoragePath;
  }

  if (temporaryDirectory) {
    await fs.rm(temporaryDirectory, {
      recursive: true,
      force: true,
    });
  }
});

function createApp({
  userId = USER_ID,
  authorizedProjectId = PROJECT_ID,
} = {}) {
  const app = express();

  app.post(
    "/projects/:projectId/media",
    (request, response, next) => {
      if (userId !== null) {
        request.auth = { userId };
      }

      if (authorizedProjectId !== null) {
        request.authorizedProject = {
          id: authorizedProjectId,
        };
      }

      next();
    },
    uploadProjectMedia,
    (request, response) => {
      response.status(201).json({
        filename: request.file?.filename,
        mimetype: request.file?.mimetype,
        size: request.file?.size,
      });
    },
  );

  app.use((error, request, response, next) => {
    response.status(error.status || 500).json({
      code: error.code || "INTERNAL_ERROR",
      message: error.publicMessage || error.message,
    });
  });

  return app;
}

function uploadFile(app, {
  projectId = PROJECT_ID,
  filename = "sample.jpg",
  contentType = "image/jpeg",
  bytes = JPEG_BYTES,
} = {}) {
  return supertest(app)
    .post(`/projects/${projectId}/media`)
    .attach("media", bytes, {
      filename,
      contentType,
    });
}

test("rejects uploads without an authenticated user", async () => {
  const response = await uploadFile(
    createApp({ userId: null }),
  );

  assert.equal(response.status, 403);
  assert.equal(
    response.body.code,
    "PROJECT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_UNAUTHORIZED",
  );
});

test("rejects uploads without verified Project ownership", async () => {

    "PROJECT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_UNAUTHORIZED",
  );
});

  );

  assert.equal(response.status, 403);
  assert.equal(
    response.body.code,
    "PROJECT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_PROJECT_MISMATCH",
  );
});

test("rejects unsupported media MIME types", async () => {

  });

test("stores an authorized image in the Project directory", async () => {
  const response = await uploadFile(createApp());

  assert.equal(response.status, 201);
  assert.match(
    response.body.filename,
    /^[a-f0-9-]{36}\.jpg$/,
  );
  assert.equal(response.body.mimetype, "image/jpeg");
  assert.equal(response.body.size, JPEG_BYTES.length);

  const { getProjectMediaDirectory } = await import(
    "../../src/services/Storage/projectMediaStorageService.js"
  );

  const projectDirectory = getProjectMediaDirectory(
    USER_ID,
    PROJECT_ID,
  );

  const expectedFilePath = path.join(
    projectDirectory,
    response.body.filename,
  );

  const savedBytes = await fs.readFile(expectedFilePath);

  assert.deepEqual(
    savedBytes,
    JPEG_BYTES,
    "Stored file contents must match the uploaded bytes.",
  );

  const relativePath = path.relative(
    temporaryDirectory,
    expectedFilePath,
  );

  assert.ok(
    relativePath &&
      relativePath !== ".." &&
      !relativePath.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) &&
      !path.isAbsolute(relativePath),
    "Uploaded media must remain inside the temporary test directory.",
  );
});


test("rejected uploads do not create stored media files", async () => {
  const rejectedProjectId = "project-rejected-upload-test";

  const { getProjectMediaDirectory } = await import(
    "../../src/services/Storage/projectMediaStorageService.js"
  );

  const rejectedProjectDirectory = getProjectMediaDirectory(
    USER_ID,
    rejectedProjectId,

  assert.ok(
    relativePath &&

      !relativePath.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) &&
      !path.isAbsolute(relativePath),
    "Test directory must remain inside isolated temporary storage.",
  );

  const requests = [
    {
      name: "missing authentication",
      app: createApp({ userId: null }),
      options: { projectId: rejectedProjectId },
      expectedStatus: 403,
    },
    {
      name: "missing ownership",
      app: createApp({ authorizedProjectId: null }),
      options: { projectId: rejectedProjectId },
      expectedStatus: 403,
    },
    {
      name: "mismatched ownership",
      app: createApp(),
      options: { projectId: rejectedProjectId },
      expectedStatus: 403,
    },
    {
      name: "unsupported MIME type",
      app: createApp({
        authorizedProjectId: rejectedProjectId,
      }),
      options: {
        projectId: rejectedProjectId,
        filename: "document.txt",
        contentType: "text/plain",
        bytes: Buffer.from("not an image"),
      },
      expectedStatus: 400,
    },
  ];

  for (const scenario of requests) {
    const response = await uploadFile(
      scenario.app,
      scenario.options,
    );

    assert.equal(
      response.status,
      scenario.expectedStatus,
      `${scenario.name}: unexpected HTTP status`,
    );

    const entries = await fs.readdir(
      rejectedProjectDirectory,
    ).catch((error) => {
      if (error.code === "ENOENT") {
        return [];
      }

      throw error;
    });

    assert.deepEqual(
      entries,
      [],
      `${scenario.name}: rejected upload must not leave stored files`,
    );
  }
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { after, before, beforeEach, mock, test } from "node:test";

const serviceModuleUrl = new URL(
  "../../src/services/Service/projectService.js",
  import.meta.url,
);

const middlewareModuleUrl = new URL(
  "../../src/middleware/project/projectOwnershipMiddleware.js",
  import.meta.url,
);

const getProjectMock = mock.fn(async () => null);

mock.module(serviceModuleUrl.href, {
  exports: {
    getAuthenticatedProject: getProjectMock,
  },
});

const { requireProjectOwnership } = await import(
  middlewareModuleUrl.href
);

beforeEach(() => {
  getProjectMock.mock.resetCalls();
});

after(() => {
  mock.restoreAll();
});

function createRequest({
  userId = "user-123",
  projectId = "project-456",
} = {}) {
  return {
    auth: userId === null ? undefined : { userId },
    params: { projectId },
  };
}

async function executeMiddleware(request) {
  const calls = [];

  await requireProjectOwnership(request, {}, (error) => {
    calls.push(error);
  });

  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);

  return calls[0];
}

test("authorizes a Project owned by the authenticated user", async () => {
  const project = {
    id: "project-456",
    title: "My Project",
  };

  getProjectMock.mock.mockImplementation(async () => project);

  const request = createRequest();
  const error = await executeMiddleware(request);

  assert.equal(error, undefined);
  assert.equal(request.authorizedProject, project);
  assert.equal(getProjectMock.mock.callCount(), 1);

  assert.deepEqual(getProjectMock.mock.calls[0].arguments[0], {
    userId: "user-123",
    projectId: "project-456",
  });
});

test("forwards a Project not found error", async () => {
  const notFoundError = Object.assign(new Error("Project not found."), {
    code: "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND",
    status: 404,
  });

  getProjectMock.mock.mockImplementation(async () => {
    throw notFoundError;
  });

  const request = createRequest();
  const error = await executeMiddleware(request);

  assert.equal(error, notFoundError);
  assert.equal(request.authorizedProject, undefined);
});

test("does not authorize a Project owned by another user", async () => {
  const ownershipError = Object.assign(
    new Error("Project not found for authenticated user."),
    {
      code: "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND",
      status: 404,
    },
  );

  getProjectMock.mock.mockImplementation(async () => {
    throw ownershipError;
  });

  const request = createRequest({
    userId: "another-user",
  });

  const error = await executeMiddleware(request);

  assert.equal(error, ownershipError);
  assert.equal(request.authorizedProject, undefined);

  assert.deepEqual(getProjectMock.mock.calls[0].arguments[0], {
    userId: "another-user",
    projectId: "project-456",
  });
});

test("forwards database errors without authorizing the Project", async () => {
  const databaseError = new Error("Database unavailable.");

  getProjectMock.mock.mockImplementation(async () => {
    throw databaseError;
  });

  const request = createRequest();
  const error = await executeMiddleware(request);

  assert.equal(error, databaseError);

  let allPassed = true;

  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(checks)) {

      allPassed = false;

    process.exitCode = 1;
