import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { beforeEach, describe, it, mock } from "node:test";

/*
 * =========================================
 * Mock Database State
 * =========================================
 */

let databaseState;

function resetDatabaseState() {
  databaseState = {
    queryQueue: [],

    executedQueries: [],

    transactions: [],
  };
}

resetDatabaseState();

/*
 * =========================================
 * Queue SQL Result
 * =========================================
 */

function queueQuery(expectedPattern, result) {
  databaseState.queryQueue.push({
    expectedPattern,

    result,
  });
}

function assertQueryQueueEmpty() {
  assert.equal(
    databaseState.queryQueue.length,
    0,
    "Not every queued SQL operation was executed.",
  );
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Mock SQL Request
 * =========================================
 */

class MockRequest {
  constructor(parent = null) {
    this.parent = parent;
    this.inputs = {};
  }

  input(name, type, value) {
    this.inputs[name] = {
      type,
      value,
    };

    return this;
  }

  async query(queryText) {
    const queued = databaseState.queryQueue.shift();

    assert.ok(queued, `Unexpected SQL query:\n${queryText}`);

    assert.match(queryText, queued.expectedPattern);

    databaseState.executedQueries.push({
      queryText,

      inputs: this.inputs,

      parent: this.parent,
    });

    if (queued.result instanceof Error) {
      throw queued.result;
    }

    if (typeof queued.result === "function") {
      return queued.result({
        queryText,

        inputs: this.inputs,

        parent: this.parent,
      });
    }

    return queued.result;
  }
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Mock SQL Transaction
 * =========================================
 */

class MockTransaction {
  constructor(pool) {
    this.pool = pool;

    this.beginCalls = [];
    this.commitCalls = 0;
    this.rollbackCalls = 0;

    databaseState.transactions.push(this);
  }

  async begin(isolationLevel) {
    this.beginCalls.push(isolationLevel);
  }

  async commit() {
    this.commitCalls += 1;
  }

  async rollback() {
    this.rollbackCalls += 1;
  }
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Mock SQL Types
 * =========================================
 */

const sqlMock = {
  UniqueIdentifier: "UniqueIdentifier",

  Bit: "Bit",

  Int: "Int",

  Char(length) {
    return `Char(${length})`;
  },

  NVarChar(length) {
    return `NVarChar(${length})`;
  },

  DateTime2(precision) {
    return `DateTime2(${precision})`;
  },

  Transaction: MockTransaction,

  Request: MockRequest,

  ISOLATION_LEVEL: {
    SERIALIZABLE: "SERIALIZABLE",
  },
};

/*
 * =========================================
 * Mock Database Pool
 * =========================================
 */

const poolMock = {

    return new MockRequest(this);

function expectValidationError(project, field) {
  assert.throws(
    () => parseProjectInput(project),
    (error) =>
      error.status === 400 &&
      Array.isArray(error.errors) &&
      error.errors.some((item) => item.field === field),
  );
}

      otp: "123456",
    });

    assert.equal(
      otpSecurity.verifyOtp({
        challengeId,

        purpose,

        otp: "654321",

        expectedHash,
      }),
      false,
    );
  });

    const firstHash = requestSecurity.hashIpAddress("192.168.1.73");

    const secondHash = requestSecurity.hashIpAddress("::ffff:192.168.1.73");

    const differentHash = requestSecurity.hashIpAddress("192.168.1.74");

  });

      get(headerName) {
        return headerName === "user-agent" ? `  ${"A".repeat(1100)}  ` : "";
      },
    };

    const userAgent = requestSecurity.getRequestUserAgent(request);

    assert.equal(userAgent.length, 1000);

    assert.equal(userAgent, "A".repeat(1000));

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import { beforeEach, describe, it, mock } from "node:test";

/*
 * =========================================
 * Environment Mock
 * =========================================
 */

let testEnvironment;

function resetEnvironment() {
  testEnvironment = {
    NODE_ENV: "development",

    SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_DAYS: 30,

    SESSION_COOKIE_NAME: "portfolio_refresh_token",

    SESSION_COOKIE_PATH: "/api",

    SESSION_COOKIE_DOMAIN: undefined,

    SESSION_COOKIE_SAME_SITE: "lax",
  };
}

resetEnvironment();

mock.module("../../src/config/environment.js", {
  exports: {
    getEnvironment() {
      return testEnvironment;
    },
  },
});

/*
 * =========================================
 * Import Security Utilities
 * =========================================
 */

const {
  clearRefreshTokenCookie,
  getRefreshTokenExpiration,
  getRefreshTokenFromRequest,
  getRefreshTokenLifetimeMs,
  setRefreshTokenCookie,
} = await import("../../src/security/sessionCookieSecurity.js");

/*
 * =========================================
 * Fake Express Response
 * =========================================
 */

function createResponse() {
  return {
    cookieCalls: [],

    clearCookieCalls: [],

    cookie(name, value, options) {
      this.cookieCalls.push({
        name,
        value,
        options,
      });

      return this;
    },

    clearCookie(name, options) {
      this.clearCookieCalls.push({
        name,
        options,
      });

      return this;
    },
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Tests
 * =========================================
 */

describe("sessionCookieSecurity", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetEnvironment();
  });

  it("calculates the configured refresh-token lifetime", () => {
    assert.equal(getRefreshTokenLifetimeMs(), 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

    const startingDate = new Date("2026-09-16T12:00:00.000Z");

    const expiration = getRefreshTokenExpiration(startingDate);

    assert.equal(expiration.toISOString(), "2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z");
  });

  it("sets a development HttpOnly refresh-token cookie", () => {
    const response = createResponse();

    const token = "development-refresh-token-12345678901234567890";

    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

    setRefreshTokenCookie(response, token, expiresAt);

    assert.equal(response.cookieCalls.length, 1);

    const cookie = response.cookieCalls[0];

    assert.equal(cookie.name, "portfolio_refresh_token");

    assert.equal(cookie.value, token);

    assert.equal(cookie.options.httpOnly, true);

    assert.equal(cookie.options.secure, false);

    assert.equal(cookie.options.sameSite, "lax");

    assert.equal(cookie.options.path, "/api");

    assert.equal(cookie.options.expires, expiresAt);

    assert.ok(cookie.options.maxAge > 0);
  });

  it("requires secure cookies in production", () => {
    testEnvironment = {
      ...testEnvironment,

      NODE_ENV: "production",
    };

    const response = createResponse();

    setRefreshTokenCookie(
      response,
      "production-refresh-token-12345678901234567890",
      new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
    );

    assert.equal(response.cookieCalls[0].options.secure, true);

    assert.equal(response.cookieCalls[0].options.httpOnly, true);
  });

  it("reads the refresh token from a Cookie header", () => {
    const request = {
      headers: {
        cookie:
          "theme=dark; portfolio_refresh_token=token%2Dvalue%2D123; language=en",
      },
    };

    assert.equal(getRefreshTokenFromRequest(request), "token-value-123");
  });

  it("supports cookies parsed by cookie-parser", () => {
    const request = {
      cookies: {
        portfolio_refresh_token: "parsed-token-value",
      },

      headers: {},
    };

    assert.equal(getRefreshTokenFromRequest(request), "parsed-token-value");
  });

  it("returns an empty value when the cookie is missing", () => {
    assert.equal(
      getRefreshTokenFromRequest({
        headers: {},
      }),
      "",
    );
  });

  it("clears the refresh-token cookie using matching options", () => {
    const response = createResponse();

    clearRefreshTokenCookie(response);

    assert.equal(response.clearCookieCalls.length, 1);

    const call = response.clearCookieCalls[0];

    assert.equal(call.name, "portfolio_refresh_token");

    assert.equal(call.options.httpOnly, true);

    assert.equal(call.options.path, "/api");

    assert.equal(call.options.sameSite, "lax");
  });

  it("rejects an invalid refresh token when setting the cookie", () => {
    assert.throws(
      () =>
        setRefreshTokenCookie(
          createResponse(),
          "short",
          new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        ),

      /valid refresh token/i,
    );
  });
});

     * =========================================
     * Refresh Login Challenge
     * =========================================
     *
     * Used when the user requests another
     * login verification code.
     */

    async refreshLoginChallenge(input) {
      serviceState.refreshChallengeInput = input;

      /*
       * A test can explicitly supply null or
       * a custom repository result.
       */

      if (serviceState.refreshChallengeResult !== null) {
        return serviceState.refreshChallengeResult;
      }

      /*
       * When an existing challenge is
       * available, return its refreshed form.
       */

      if (serviceState.challenge) {
        return {
          ...serviceState.challenge,

          codeHash: input.codeHash,

          attemptCount: 0,

          maximumAttempts:
            input.maximumAttempts ??
            serviceState.challenge.maximumAttempts ??
            5,

          expiresAt: input.expiresAt,

          lastSentAt: input.lastSentAt,

          requestIpHash:
            input.requestIpHash ?? serviceState.challenge.requestIpHash,

          verifiedAt: null,

          consumedAt: null,
        };
      }

      /*
       * No challenge means the conditional
       * database update did not find an
       * eligible login challenge.
       */

      return null;
    },

    async deleteLoginChallengeById(challengeId) {
      serviceState.deletedChallengeId = challengeId;

      return true;
    },

    async getLoginChallengeById() {
      return serviceState.challenge;

    async recordFailedLoginOtpAttempt(input) {

import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, it } from "node:test";

process.env.PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_PATH = path.resolve(
  "test",
  ".tmp",
  "profile-pictures",
);

const {
  createProfilePictureStorageKey,
  deleteOwnedProfilePicture,
  getProfilePictureUserDirectory,
  getProfilePictureUserStoragePath,
  resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath,
} = await import("../../src/services/Storage/profilePictureStorageService.js");

const USER_ID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";
const OTHER_USER_ID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";

describe("profilePictureStorageService", () => {
  it("creates a storage key inside the authenticated user's directory", () => {
    const fileName = "picture.jpg";

    const storageKey = createProfilePictureStorageKey(USER_ID, fileName);

    assert.equal(
      storageKey,
      `${getProfilePictureUserDirectory(USER_ID)}/${fileName}`,
    );
  });

  it("resolves an owned storage key inside the authenticated user's directory", () => {
    const fileName = "picture.jpg";

    const storageKey = createProfilePictureStorageKey(USER_ID, fileName);

    const resolvedPath = resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(USER_ID, storageKey);

    assert.equal(
      resolvedPath,
      path.resolve(getProfilePictureUserStoragePath(USER_ID), fileName),
    );
  });

  it("rejects a storage key belonging to another user", () => {
    const storageKey = createProfilePictureStorageKey(
      OTHER_USER_ID,
      "picture.jpg",
    );

    assert.throws(
      () => resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(USER_ID, storageKey),
      /does not belong to the authenticated user/,
    );
  });

  it("rejects path traversal inside the authenticated user's storage key", () => {
    const userDirectory = getProfilePictureUserDirectory(USER_ID);

    const storageKey = `${userDirectory}/../outside.jpg`;

    assert.throws(
      () => resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(USER_ID, storageKey),
      /storage key is invalid/,
    );
  });

  it("rejects nested paths inside the authenticated user's directory", () => {
    const userDirectory = getProfilePictureUserDirectory(USER_ID);

    const storageKey = `${userDirectory}/nested/picture.jpg`;

    assert.throws(
      () => resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(USER_ID, storageKey),
      /storage key is invalid/,
    );
  });
  it("deletes an owned profile-picture file", async () => {
    const fileName = "delete-me.jpg";

    const storageKey = createProfilePictureStorageKey(USER_ID, fileName);

    const filePath = resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(USER_ID, storageKey);

    await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(filePath), {
      recursive: true,
    });

    await fs.writeFile(filePath, "temporary profile-picture test file");

    const result = await deleteOwnedProfilePicture(USER_ID, storageKey);

    assert.deepEqual(result, {
      deleted: true,
      storageKey,
    });

    await assert.rejects(
      fs.access(filePath),
      (error) => error?.code === "ENOENT",
    );
  });

  it("treats an already-missing owned file as successfully cleaned up", async () => {
    const storageKey = createProfilePictureStorageKey(
      USER_ID,
      "already-missing.jpg",
    );

    const filePath = resolveOwnedProfilePicturePath(USER_ID, storageKey);

    await fs.rm(filePath, {
      force: true,
    });

    const result = await deleteOwnedProfilePicture(USER_ID, storageKey);

    assert.deepEqual(result, {
      deleted: false,
      storageKey,
    });
  });
});

describe("profileService profile-picture cleanup", () => {
  it("deletes an uncommitted profile picture", async () => {
    repositoryProfile = createProfile([COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY]);

    deletedPictureInput = null;

    const result = await deleteUncommittedProfilePicture({
      userId: USER_ID,
      storageKey: TEMPORARY_STORAGE_KEY,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(deletedPictureInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,
      storageKey: TEMPORARY_STORAGE_KEY,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(result, {
      deleted: true,
      storageKey: TEMPORARY_STORAGE_KEY,
    });
  });

  it("does not delete a committed profile picture", async () => {
    repositoryProfile = createProfile([COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY]);

    deletedPictureInput = null;

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        deleteUncommittedProfilePicture({
          userId: USER_ID,
          storageKey: COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY,
        }),
      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "PROFILE_PICTURE_IS_COMMITTED");

        assert.equal(error.status, 409);

        return true;
      },
    );

    assert.equal(
      deletedPictureInput,
      null,
      "Committed profile picture must not reach filesystem deletion.",
    );
  });
  it("deletes the old committed picture after a successful profile save", async () => {
    const previousProfile = createProfile([COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY]);

    const updatedProfile = createProfile([REPLACEMENT_STORAGE_KEY]);

    repositoryProfile = previousProfile;
    replacementProfile = updatedProfile;
    replacementError = null;
    replacementInput = null;
    deletedPictureInput = null;

    const profileInput = {
      profilePictures: [
        {
          storageKey: REPLACEMENT_STORAGE_KEY,
        },
      ],
    };

    const result = await updateAuthenticatedProfile({
      userId: USER_ID,
      profile: profileInput,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(replacementInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,
      profile: profileInput,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(deletedPictureInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,
      storageKey: COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY,
    });

    assert.equal(result, updatedProfile);
  });

  it("does not delete the old committed picture when the profile save fails", async () => {
    const previousProfile = createProfile([COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY]);

    repositoryProfile = previousProfile;

    replacementProfile = null;
    replacementError = new Error("Simulated database save failure.");

    replacementInput = null;
    deletedPictureInput = null;

    const profileInput = {
      profilePictures: [
        {
          storageKey: REPLACEMENT_STORAGE_KEY,
        },
      ],
    };

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        updateAuthenticatedProfile({
          userId: USER_ID,
          profile: profileInput,
        }),
      /Simulated database save failure/,
    );

    assert.deepEqual(replacementInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,
      profile: profileInput,
    });

    assert.equal(
      deletedPictureInput,
      null,
      "The old committed picture must not be deleted when the database save fails.",
    );
  });

  it("does not delete a picture that remains committed after the profile save", async () => {
    const previousProfile = createProfile([COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY]);

    const updatedProfile = createProfile([COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY]);

    repositoryProfile = previousProfile;
    replacementProfile = updatedProfile;
    replacementError = null;
    replacementInput = null;
    deletedPictureInput = null;

    const profileInput = {
      profilePictures: [
        {
          storageKey: COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY,
        },
      ],
    };

    const result = await updateAuthenticatedProfile({
      userId: USER_ID,
      profile: profileInput,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(replacementInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,
      profile: profileInput,
    });

    assert.equal(
      deletedPictureInput,
      null,
      "A picture that remains committed must not be deleted.",
    );

    assert.equal(result, updatedProfile);
  });

  it("deletes the old committed picture after saving the default avatar", async () => {
    const previousProfile = createProfile([COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY]);

    const updatedProfile = createProfile([]);

    repositoryProfile = previousProfile;
    replacementProfile = updatedProfile;
    replacementError = null;
    replacementInput = null;
    deletedPictureInput = null;

    const profileInput = {
      profilePictures: [],
    };

    const result = await updateAuthenticatedProfile({
      userId: USER_ID,
      profile: profileInput,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(replacementInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,
      profile: profileInput,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(deletedPictureInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,
      storageKey: COMMITTED_STORAGE_KEY,
    });

    assert.equal(result, updatedProfile);
  });
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

/*
 * =========================================
 * Repository Test State
 * =========================================
 */

let repositoryState;

function resetRepositoryState() {
  repositoryState = {
    challenges: new Map(),

    auditEvents: [],

    deletedChallengeIds: [],

    deletedEmails: [],

    incrementedChallengeIds: [],

    markedVerifiedInput: null,

    completedRegistrationInput: null,
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Repository Mock
 * =========================================
 */

const repositoryMock = {
  async createRegistrationChallenge(input) {
    const challenge = {
      id: input.id,

      userId: null,

      pendingEmail: input.email,

      normalizedPendingEmail: input.normalizedEmail,

      purpose: "registration",

      codeHash: input.codeHash,

      continuationTokenHash: null,

      attemptCount: 0,

      maximumAttempts: input.maximumAttempts,

      expiresAt: input.expiresAt,

      lastSentAt: input.lastSentAt,

      verifiedAt: null,

      consumedAt: null,

      requestIpHash: input.requestIpHash,

      createdAt: new Date(),
    };

    repositoryState.challenges.set(challenge.id, challenge);

    return challenge;
  },

  async deleteOpenRegistrationChallenges(normalizedEmail) {
    repositoryState.deletedEmails.push(normalizedEmail);

    let deletedCount = 0;

    for (const [challengeId, challenge] of repositoryState.challenges) {
      if (
        challenge.normalizedPendingEmail === normalizedEmail &&
        challenge.purpose === "registration" &&
        !challenge.consumedAt
      ) {
        repositoryState.challenges.delete(challengeId);

        deletedCount += 1;
      }
    }

    return deletedCount;
  },

  async deleteRegistrationChallengeById(challengeId) {
    repositoryState.deletedChallengeIds.push(challengeId);

    return repositoryState.challenges.delete(challengeId);
  },

  async getRegistrationChallengeById(challengeId) {
    return repositoryState.challenges.get(challengeId) || null;
  },

  async incrementRegistrationChallengeAttempt(challengeId) {
    repositoryState.incrementedChallengeIds.push(challengeId);

    const challenge = repositoryState.challenges.get(challengeId);

    if (
      !challenge ||
      challenge.verifiedAt ||
      challenge.consumedAt ||
      new Date(challenge.expiresAt) <= new Date() ||
      challenge.attemptCount >= challenge.maximumAttempts
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    challenge.attemptCount += 1;

    repositoryState.challenges.set(challengeId, challenge);

    return {
      attemptCount: challenge.attemptCount,

      maximumAttempts: challenge.maximumAttempts,
    };
  },

  async markRegistrationChallengeVerified(input) {
    repositoryState.markedVerifiedInput = input;

    const challenge = repositoryState.challenges.get(input.challengeId);

    if (
      !challenge ||
      challenge.verifiedAt ||
      challenge.consumedAt ||
      new Date(challenge.expiresAt) <= new Date() ||
      challenge.attemptCount >= challenge.maximumAttempts
    ) {
      return null;
    }

    const verifiedChallenge = {
      ...challenge,

      continuationTokenHash: input.continuationTokenHash,

      expiresAt: input.continuationExpiresAt,

      verifiedAt: new Date(),
    };

    repositoryState.challenges.set(input.challengeId, verifiedChallenge);

    return verifiedChallenge;
  },

  async createLoginAuditEvent(event) {
    repositoryState.auditEvents.push(event);

    return {
      id: repositoryState.auditEvents.length,

      createdAt: new Date(),
    };
  },

  async completeRegistration(input) {
    repositoryState.completedRegistrationInput = input;

    return {
      user: {
        id: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",

        email: "jean@example.com",

        normalizedEmail: "jean@example.com",

        emailVerifiedAt: new Date(),

        accountStatus: "active",

        failedLoginCount: 0,

        lockedUntil: null,

        lastLoginAt: null,

        createdAt: new Date(),

        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },

      roles: ["user"],
    };
  },
};

/*
 * =========================================
 * Request Factory
 * =========================================
 */

function createRequest() {
  return {
    ip: "192.0.2.10",

    headers: {
      "user-agent": "RegistrationServiceTest/1.0",
    },

    get(headerName) {
      return this.headers[String(headerName).toLowerCase()];
    },
  };
}

/*
 * =========================================
 * Challenge Factory
 * =========================================
 */

function createStoredChallenge({
  challengeId = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",

  email = "jean@example.com",

  otp = "123456",

  attemptCount = 0,

  maximumAttempts = 5,

  expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000),
} = {}) {
  const challenge = {
    id: challengeId,

    userId: null,

    pendingEmail: email,

    normalizedPendingEmail: email.toLowerCase(),

    purpose: "registration",

    codeHash: hashOtp({
      challengeId,

      purpose: "registration",

      otp,
    }),

    continuationTokenHash: null,

    attemptCount,

    maximumAttempts,

    expiresAt,

    lastSentAt: new Date(),

    verifiedAt: null,

    consumedAt: null,

    requestIpHash: null,

    createdAt: new Date(),
  };

  repositoryState.challenges.set(challengeId, challenge);

  return challenge;
}

describe("registrationService", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetRepositoryState();
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Request Registration
   * =========================================
   */

  it("creates and sends a registration OTP without storing plaintext", async () => {
    let deliveredEmail = null;

    const result = await requestRegistration({
      email: "  Jean@Example.COM  ",

      request: createRequest(),

      async sendRegistrationOtp(emailMessage) {
        deliveredEmail = emailMessage;
      },
    });

    assert.ok(result.challengeId);

    assert.equal(result.email, "je***@example.com");

    assert.match(deliveredEmail.otp, /^\d{6}$/);

    assert.equal(deliveredEmail.email, "jean@example.com");

    assert.equal(deliveredEmail.expiresInMinutes, 10);

    const storedChallenge = repositoryState.challenges.get(result.challengeId);

    assert.ok(storedChallenge);

    assert.equal(storedChallenge.pendingEmail, "jean@example.com");

    assert.notEqual(storedChallenge.codeHash, deliveredEmail.otp);

    assert.equal(storedChallenge.codeHash.length, 64);

    assert.equal(
      verifyOtp({
        challengeId: result.challengeId,

        purpose: "registration",

        otp: deliveredEmail.otp,

        expectedHash: storedChallenge.codeHash,
      }),
      true,
    );

    assert.deepEqual(repositoryState.deletedEmails, ["jean@example.com"]);

    assert.equal(repositoryState.auditEvents.length, 1);

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.auditEvents[0].eventType,
      "registration_requested",
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.auditEvents[0].wasSuccessful, true);
  });

  it("removes the challenge when OTP email delivery fails", async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        requestRegistration({
          email: "jean@example.com",

          request: createRequest(),

            throw new Error("Email provider unavailable");
          },
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "REGISTRATION_EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED");

        assert.equal(error.status, 503);

        return true;
      },
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.challenges.size, 0);

    assert.equal(repositoryState.deletedChallengeIds.length, 1);

    assert.equal(repositoryState.auditEvents.length, 1);

    assert.equal(repositoryState.auditEvents[0].wasSuccessful, false);

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.auditEvents[0].failureReason,

    );
  });

   * =========================================
   * Incorrect OTP
   * =========================================
   */

    });

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        verifyRegistrationOtp({
          challengeId: challenge.id,

          otp: "654321",

          request: createRequest(),
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "REGISTRATION_OTP_INCORRECT");

        assert.equal(error.details.attemptsRemaining, 4);

        return true;
      },
    );

    const updatedChallenge = repositoryState.challenges.get(challenge.id);

    assert.equal(updatedChallenge.attemptCount, 1);

    assert.deepEqual(repositoryState.incrementedChallengeIds, [challenge.id]);

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.auditEvents[0].eventType,
      "registration_otp_verified",
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.auditEvents[0].wasSuccessful, false);

    assert.equal(repositoryState.auditEvents[0].failureReason, "incorrect_otp");
  });

  it("blocks the challenge when the last OTP attempt fails", async () => {
    const challenge = createStoredChallenge({
      otp: "123456",

      attemptCount: 4,

      maximumAttempts: 5,
    });

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        verifyRegistrationOtp({
          challengeId: challenge.id,

          otp: "654321",

          request: createRequest(),
        }),

        assert.equal(error.status, 429);

        return true;
      },
    );

    assert.equal(updatedChallenge.attemptCount, 5);

      otp: "123456",
    });

    const result = await verifyRegistrationOtp({
      challengeId: challenge.id,

      otp: "123456",

      request: createRequest(),
    });

    assert.equal(result.challengeId, challenge.id);

    assert.ok(result.continuationToken);

    assert.ok(result.expiresAt);

   * =========================================

  it("hashes the password and delegates atomic account creation", async () => {
    const challengeId = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222";

    const continuationToken =
      "registration-test-continuation-token-that-is-long-enough";

    const password = "A secure test password 2026!";

    const result = await completeRegistration({
      challengeId,

      password,

    assert.ok(repositoryInput);

    assert.equal(repositoryInput.challengeId, challengeId);

    assert.notEqual(repositoryInput.passwordHash, password);

    assert.match(repositoryInput.passwordHash, /^\$argon2id\$/);

    assert.equal(
      await verifyPassword(repositoryInput.passwordHash, password),
      true,
    );

    const expectedTokenHash = hashToken(
      continuationToken,
      "registration-continuation",
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryInput.continuationTokenHash, expectedTokenHash);

    assert.equal(result.user.email, "jean@example.com");

    assert.deepEqual(result.roles, ["user"]);

    assert.equal(result.message, "Your account was created successfully.");
  });

  it("rejects a password that does not meet the password policy", async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        completeRegistration({
          challengeId: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",

          continuationToken:
            "registration-test-continuation-token-that-is-long-enough",

          password: "short",
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "INVALID_PASSWORD");

        assert.equal(error.status, 400);

        return true;
      },
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.completedRegistrationInput, null);
  });
});

function createSessionRecord(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: SESSION_ID,

    userId: USER_ID,

    refreshTokenHash: "a".repeat(64),

    deviceName: "Chrome on Windows",

    userAgent: "Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/140.0 Windows NT 10.0",

    ipAddressHash: "b".repeat(64),

    createdAt: new Date("2026-09-16T12:00:00.000Z"),

    lastUsedAt: new Date("2026-09-16T12:00:00.000Z"),

    expiresAt: new Date("2026-10-16T12:00:00.000Z"),

    revokedAt: null,

    revocationReason: null,

    ...overrides,
  };
}

const {
  createAuthenticatedSession,
  createPublicSession,
  detectDeviceName,
  getAuthenticatedSession,
  getUserSessions,
  refreshAuthenticatedSession,
  revokeCurrentSession,
  revokeEveryUserSession,
  revokeUserSession,
} = await import("../../src/services/Service/sessionService.js");

const { hashToken, verifyToken } =
  await import("../../src/security/tokenSecurity.js");

/*
 * =========================================
 * Request Factory
 * =========================================
 */

function createRequest({
  userAgent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0) Chrome/140.0",
  ip = "192.0.2.25",
} = {}) {
  return {
    ip,

    headers: {
      "user-agent": userAgent,
    },

    get(headerName) {
      return this.headers[String(headerName).toLowerCase()];
    },
  };
}

describe("sessionService", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    resetRepositoryState();
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Device Detection
   * =========================================
   */

  it("detects common browser and operating-system names", () => {
    assert.equal(
      detectDeviceName("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0) Edg/140.0"),
      "Edge on Windows",
    );

    assert.equal(
      detectDeviceName("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0) Chrome/140.0"),
      "Chrome on Windows",
    );

    assert.equal(
      detectDeviceName("Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone) Version/18.0 Safari/605.1"),
      "Safari on iOS",
    );

    assert.equal(
      detectDeviceName(
        "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) Firefox/140.0",
      ),
      "Firefox on macOS",
    );

    assert.equal(detectDeviceName(""), "Unknown device");
  });

  it("detects the Postman API client", () => {
    assert.equal(
      detectDeviceName("PostmanRuntime/7.49.1"),
      "Postman API Client",
    );
  });

  it("detects other common API clients", () => {
    assert.equal(detectDeviceName("insomnia/11.5.0"), "Insomnia API Client");

    assert.equal(detectDeviceName("curl/8.15.0"), "cURL Client");

    assert.equal(detectDeviceName("HTTPie/3.2.4"), "HTTPie Client");
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Session Creation
   * =========================================
   */

  it("creates a session with a hashed refresh token", async () => {
    const result = await createAuthenticatedSession({
      userId: USER_ID,

      request: createRequest(),
    });

    assert.ok(result.refreshToken);

    assert.ok(repositoryState.createInput);

    assert.equal(repositoryState.createInput.userId, USER_ID);

    assert.notEqual(
      repositoryState.createInput.refreshTokenHash,
      result.refreshToken,
    );

    assert.equal(
      verifyToken({
        token: result.refreshToken,

        purpose: "session-refresh",

        expectedHash: repositoryState.createInput.refreshTokenHash,
      }),
      true,
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.createInput.deviceName, "Chrome on Windows");

    assert.equal(result.session.id, SESSION_ID);

    assert.equal(result.session.isCurrent, true);

    assert.equal(result.session.refreshTokenHash, undefined);

    assert.equal(result.session.ipAddressHash, undefined);
  });

  it("stores Postman as the device name for a Postman request", async () => {
    await createAuthenticatedSession({
      userId: USER_ID,

      request: createRequest({
        userAgent: "PostmanRuntime/7.49.1",
      }),
    });

    assert.equal(repositoryState.createInput.deviceName, "Postman API Client");

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.createInput.userAgent,
      "PostmanRuntime/7.49.1",
    );
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Session Refresh
   * =========================================
   */

  it("rotates a valid session refresh token", async () => {
    const currentToken = "current-refresh-token-123456789012345678901234";

    const existingSession = createSessionRecord({
      refreshTokenHash: hashToken(currentToken, "session-refresh"),
    });

    repositoryState.findActiveResult = {
      session: existingSession,

      user: {
        id: USER_ID,

        email: "jean@example.com",

        accountStatus: "active",
      },

      roles: ["user"],
    };

    repositoryState.rotationResult = createSessionRecord({
      lastUsedAt: new Date("2026-09-16T13:00:00.000Z"),
    });

    const result = await refreshAuthenticatedSession({
      refreshToken: currentToken,

      request: createRequest(),
    });

    assert.ok(result.refreshToken);

    assert.notEqual(result.refreshToken, currentToken);

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.findHash,
      hashToken(currentToken, "session-refresh"),
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.rotateInput.sessionId, SESSION_ID);

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.rotateInput.currentRefreshTokenHash,
      repositoryState.findHash,
    );

    assert.equal(
      verifyToken({
        token: result.refreshToken,

        purpose: "session-refresh",

        expectedHash: repositoryState.rotateInput.newRefreshTokenHash,
      }),
      true,
    );

    assert.equal(result.user.email, "jean@example.com");

    assert.deepEqual(result.roles, ["user"]);
  });

  it("rejects a malformed refresh token before querying the repository", async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        refreshAuthenticatedSession({
          refreshToken: "too-short",

          request: createRequest(),
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID");

        assert.equal(error.status, 401);

        return true;
      },
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.findHash, null);
  });

  it("rejects a refresh token with no active session", async () => {
    repositoryState.findActiveResult = null;

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        refreshAuthenticatedSession({
          refreshToken: "missing-session-token-123456789012345678901234",

          request: createRequest(),
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "SESSION_NOT_FOUND");

        assert.equal(error.status, 401);

        return true;
      },
    );
  });

  it("rejects a refresh when token rotation loses a concurrency race", async () => {
    const currentToken = "current-refresh-token-123456789012345678901234";

    repositoryState.findActiveResult = {
      session: createSessionRecord(),

      user: {
        id: USER_ID,

        email: "jean@example.com",

        accountStatus: "active",
      },

      roles: ["user"],
    };

    repositoryState.rotationResult = null;

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        refreshAuthenticatedSession({
          refreshToken: currentToken,

          request: createRequest(),
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "SESSION_REFRESH_CONFLICT");

        assert.equal(error.status, 409);

        return true;
      },
    );
  });

  /*

   * Current Authenticated Session
   * =========================================
   */

  it("returns the authenticated user and current session", async () => {
    const refreshToken = "current-session-token-123456789012345678901234";

    repositoryState.findActiveResult = {
      session: createSessionRecord(),

      user: {
        id: USER_ID,

        email: "jean@example.com",

        emailVerifiedAt: new Date("2026-09-16T12:00:00.000Z"),

        accountStatus: "active",

        /*
         * This security field must not be
         * introduced by the session mapper.
         * The repository should already

         */

        passwordHash: undefined,
      },

      roles: ["user"],
    };

    const result = await getAuthenticatedSession({
      refreshToken,
    });

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.findHash,
      hashToken(refreshToken, "session-refresh"),
    );

    assert.equal(result.user.id, USER_ID);

    assert.equal(result.user.email, "jean@example.com");

    assert.deepEqual(result.roles, ["user"]);

    assert.equal(result.session.id, SESSION_ID);

    assert.equal(result.session.isCurrent, true);

    assert.equal(result.session.refreshTokenHash, undefined);

    assert.equal(result.session.userAgent, undefined);

    assert.equal(result.session.ipAddressHash, undefined);

    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(result).includes(refreshToken), false);
  });

  it("rejects a malformed current-session refresh token", async () => {
    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        getAuthenticatedSession({
          refreshToken: "too-short",
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID");

        assert.equal(error.status, 401);

        return true;
      },
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.findHash, null);
  });

  it("rejects a current-session token with no active session", async () => {
    repositoryState.findActiveResult = null;

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        getAuthenticatedSession({
          refreshToken: "missing-current-session-token-123456789012345678",
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "SESSION_NOT_FOUND");

        assert.equal(error.status, 401);

        return true;
      },
    );

    assert.ok(repositoryState.findHash);
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Session Listing
   * =========================================
   */

  it("creates public-safe session responses", async () => {
    repositoryState.activeSessions = [
      createSessionRecord({
        id: SESSION_ID,
      }),

      createSessionRecord({
        id: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",

        deviceName: "Safari on iOS",
      }),
    ];

    const sessions = await getUserSessions({
      userId: USER_ID,

      currentSessionId: SESSION_ID,
    });

    assert.equal(repositoryState.listUserId, USER_ID);

    assert.equal(sessions.length, 2);

    assert.equal(sessions[0].isCurrent, true);

    assert.equal(sessions[1].isCurrent, false);

    assert.equal(sessions[0].refreshTokenHash, undefined);

    assert.equal(sessions[0].userAgent, undefined);

    assert.equal(sessions[0].ipAddressHash, undefined);
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Session Revocation
   * =========================================
   */

  it("revokes one owned session", async () => {
    repositoryState.revokedSession = createSessionRecord({
      revokedAt: new Date(),

      revocationReason: "user_revoked",
    });

    const result = await revokeUserSession({
      sessionId: SESSION_ID,

      userId: USER_ID,
    });

    assert.deepEqual(repositoryState.revokeInput, {
      sessionId: SESSION_ID,

      userId: USER_ID,

      reason: "user_revoked",
    });

    assert.equal(result.sessionId, SESSION_ID);

    assert.ok(result.revokedAt);
  });

  it("rejects revocation of a missing session", async () => {
    repositoryState.revokedSession = null;

    await assert.rejects(
      () =>
        revokeUserSession({
          sessionId: SESSION_ID,

          userId: USER_ID,
        }),

      (error) => {
        assert.equal(error.code, "SESSION_NOT_FOUND");

        assert.equal(error.status, 404);

        return true;
      },
    );
  });

  it("revokes the current session using its token hash", async () => {
    const refreshToken = "logout-refresh-token-123456789012345678901234";

    repositoryState.revokedByHashSession = createSessionRecord({
      revokedAt: new Date(),

      revocationReason: "logout",
    });

    const result = await revokeCurrentSession({
      refreshToken,
    });

    assert.equal(result.revoked, true);

    assert.equal(
      repositoryState.revokeByHashInput.refreshTokenHash,
      hashToken(refreshToken, "session-refresh"),
    );

    assert.equal(repositoryState.revokeByHashInput.reason, "logout");
  });

  it("does not query the repository when logout has no token", async () => {
    const result = await revokeCurrentSession({
      refreshToken: "",
    });

    assert.deepEqual(result, {
      revoked: false,
    });

    assert.equal(repositoryState.revokeByHashInput, null);
  });

  it("revokes every user session with an optional exception", async () => {
    repositoryState.revokeAllCount = 4;

    const result = await revokeEveryUserSession({
      userId: USER_ID,

      exceptSessionId: SESSION_ID,

      reason: "password_changed",
    });

    assert.equal(result.revokedCount, 4);

    assert.deepEqual(repositoryState.revokeAllInput, {
      userId: USER_ID,

      exceptSessionId: SESSION_ID,

      reason: "password_changed",
    });
  });

  /*
   * =========================================
   * Public Mapping
   * =========================================
   */

  it("maps an individual session without exposing internal security fields", () => {
    const publicSession = createPublicSession(
      createSessionRecord(),
      SESSION_ID,
    );

    assert.deepEqual(
      Object.keys(publicSession).sort(),
      [
        "createdAt",
        "deviceName",
        "expiresAt",
        "id",
        "isCurrent",
        "lastUsedAt",
      ].sort(),
    );

    assert.equal(publicSession.refreshTokenHash, undefined);

    assert.equal(publicSession.userAgent, undefined);

    assert.equal(publicSession.ipAddressHash, undefined);
  });
});

import dotenv from "dotenv";
import sql from "mssql";

dotenv.config({ path: ".env.local-sql" });

const config = {
  server: process.env.DB_HOST,
  port: Number(process.env.DB_PORT),
  database: process.env.DB_NAME,
  user: process.env.DB_USER,
  password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD,
  options: {
    encrypt: true,
    trustServerCertificate: true,
  },
};

if (!config.password) {
  throw new Error("Missing local SQL test password.");
}

let pool;

try {
  pool = await sql.connect(config);

  const result = await pool.request().query(`
    SELECT
      DB_NAME() AS databaseName,
      SUSER_SNAME() AS loginName,
      COUNT(*) AS userCount
    FROM dbo.users;
  `);

  console.log(result.recordset[0]);
} catch (error) {
  console.error("SQL connection failed:", error.message);
  process.exitCode = 1;
} finally {
  if (pool) {
    await pool.close();
  }
}
